features.detail: Default multimodal clip model. Input: a video link or upload. Process: analyses visuals (objects, colours, actions, on-screen text such as scoreboards and logos), audio (which speaker is talking, laughter, music, sound events), sentiment (happiness, sorrow, surprise) and applies genre-specific narrative structures, then reasons across scenes. Output: a set of short clips ranked by Virality Score. Works on vlogs, sports, TV, news, music, not only talking heads. Selected under 'Clip model' in the submit panel.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per source minute. Clipping by visual objects, sound and emotion is Pro on the pricing page; Free and Starter clip by spoken words.
features.notable: Model choice is a single dropdown with the smart model as default; Content Studio can do the same for 'find the remixable moment' in an adviser's long webinar or podcast.

features.detail: Older transcript-only model. Clips talking-head video well, accepts only keywords that appear in the original video, understands speaker positions, no sentiment, narrative or cross-scene reasoning. OpusClip uses the last-used model (ClipAnything or ClipBasic) for auto-imported videos.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per source minute.

features.detail: Optional prompt box when submitting with ClipAnything. Prompt types: find a moment, an action, an emotion, a character, or create a compilation. Examples from the manual: 'Find the moments most likely to go viral on social media', 'Find all the laughing scenes', 'Compile all Man City's scoring'. Optional genre selector; narrative templates ('All suitable narrative templates are selected by default'). Prompts must be English; prompts cannot change aspect ratio, add effects or set clip length (that is 'Clip Length'). Results page lets you re-prompt and regenerate from the same video; with ClipAnything the virality score also checks relevance to the prompt.
features.limits_or_cost: Prompt-to-clip and topic search listed under Pro on the pricing page; reprompting listed from Starter.
features.notable: A written manual of good and bad prompts with examples; Content Studio's Remix prompt box should ship with the same do/do-not list and example chips.

features.detail: Before processing: 'Clip Length' dropdown defaulting to 'Auto (0m-3m)'; 'Processing timeframe' slider to clip only part of the source (credits charged only for that range); 'Speech Language' with 'Translate To'; Auto headline toggle; caption style from 'Quick Presets' or 'No Caption'; brand template; option to save model, genre and presets as defaults. Approximate clip yield: 0-3 min source gives 1-2 clips, 10-30 min gives 5-21, 60-120 min gives 32-42, over 120 min gives 42-55.
features.limits_or_cost: Basic copilot (timeframe and length) on Free; source up to 10 hours.
features.notable: Timeframe slider doubles as a cost control; saved defaults make repeat submissions one click.

features.detail: Each clip gets a 0-99 score shown next to it in 'Grid View' or 'List View'. Results are sorted highest first by default; you can also sort chronologically. Score is built from four factors: Hook (does the intro grab attention and relate to the topic), Flow (logical progression, satisfying end), Value (value, emotional resonance, personal connection), Trend (fit with current trends). Factors are not shown as separate sub-scores.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter and Pro only; hidden on Free.
features.notable: The four-factor rubric (Hook, Flow, Value, Trend) is a ready-made scoring frame for ranking 'proven content' in a Content Studio inspiration feed.

features.detail: Per clip: AI-generated title and description, transcript, Virality Score, edit, download HD, Export to XML, schedule. Heart and thumbs-down feedback (disliked clips are hidden), sort by score or original order, filters, 'Select' for bulk actions, 'AI tools' menu (for example Video dubbing). Pro can save projects to cloud storage so they do not expire.
features.limits_or_cost: Free media expires after 3 days, Starter after 29 days; Pro has 100GB storage.
features.notable: Thumbs-down hides the clip and feeds the model; a cheap feedback loop to copy for Remix outputs.

features.detail: Seven layouts: Fill (crop speaker to 9:16), Fit (crop to 4:3 with padding top and bottom), Split (two speakers in frame), Three, Four (panels), Screenshare (screen top half, speaker bottom half), Gameplay (30% speaker top, 70% gameplay). Set defaults in the brand template under 'Clip layout settings' (AI picks per scene when several are selected), per clip via 'Applicable auto layout', or per segment via the 'Layout' dropdown on the canvas. 'Pin first speaker' keeps the first speaker in the top slot. Manual reframe via the Crop icon or double-click.
features.limits_or_cost: Free reframes to 9:16 only; 1:1 and 16:9 on Pro; dynamic layout switch and screenshare layout from Starter.

features.detail: Two modes. Moving Speaker Tracking (automatic, default) follows the active speaker using voice and motion cues with gradual frame shifts. Manual Subject Tracking: select a scene on the timeline, turn on 'Tracker', click the subject (products, animals, vehicles, text, faces, full body, gestures), widen the box if needed, pick different subjects per scene, start tracking.
features.limits_or_cost: Moving object tracking listed under Pro.

features.detail: Auto captions on every clip. Edit words in the transcript ('Edit'), add missing words (timestamps auto-adjust), drag word timing handles, drag captions anywhere on the canvas. Right sidebar 'Captions' tab, fonts section: font style, size, colour, stroke, shadow, case. Brand template sets colour, position and animation. Upload own SRT supported. To remove captions for new projects, use a brand template with captions toggled off; existing clips must be turned off one by one. Cannot remove burned-in captions.
features.limits_or_cost: Animated caption templates carry a watermark on Free. Custom fonts: up to 2 on Pro.

features.detail: 'AI Emoji' toggle under 'AI Enhance' adds emojis matched to the caption text; emojis can be moved on the canvas or added per word via 'Add' > 'Emoji'. features.detail: Button at top left of the editor with three tools. Remove Fillers: highlights 'um', 'uh', 'you know' and stutters in the transcript, checklist of filler types to keep or remove, one-click remove. Remove Pauses: slider for the silence threshold, default 0.5 s, one-click cut. Remove Bad Takes: 'Detect now' finds retakes, restarts, self-corrections and repeated phrases, shows a count, remove one by one or 'Remove all'. Nothing is cut without approval; 'Filter out' hides deleted parts.

features.limits_or_cost: Pro. Template intro/outro max 1 minute and 200MB each.

features.detail: AI Enhance > Auto Censor. Default curse-word list; caption masking style '**' or '--'; audio set to beep, mute or leave. Manual: click a word, 'censor word', apply to one or every instance; 'Revert censorship' undoes all. Enterprise can create custom lists in Asset Library ('Add My List'), and copy, rename, delete lists. API has a Censor Job endpoint.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro uses the default list; custom censored word lists are Business/Enterprise.
features.notable: A custom word list that masks captions and audio is the pattern for an adviser compliance list (for example 'guaranteed returns', 'risk-free'); Content Studio should flag rather than beep.

features.detail: Quick Start 'Video dubbing': add video (YouTube link, upload, Google Drive), choose target language, 'Dub Video'; output is a new asset in the project. Also from editor 'AI enhance' > 'Video dubbing' > 'Select dubbing language', results page 'AI tools', or 'Bulk dub' on selected clips. Voice is cloned automatically from the source; multiple speakers all get the primary speaker's voice. 25 languages. Transcript edits update subtitles but do not regenerate dubbed audio. Lip sync not mentioned.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and Business; 10 credits per minute.
features.notable: Zero-setup voice clone from the source clip; could let an adviser publish the same remix in Mandarin (check language list).

features.detail: At submit: 'Get Clips in 1 Click' > 'Speech Language' > 'Translate To'. Only English is a translation target. Multi-language transcription on all plans; API says 20+ languages.
features.limits_or_cost: English-only target.

features.detail: Upscale: paste YouTube link, upload or Google Drive; output sharper HD, downloaded from the History tab (kept 7 days). 4K export only when the source is true 3840x2160; OpusClip does not upscale on export. Download via hover, bulk download, clip detail or editor 'Export'.
features.limits_or_cost: Upscale: Pro, Max, Business, videos up to 5 min, base cost shown on button (example 23 credits) plus 11 credits per 10 s for 4K. 4K export Pro; 4K posting Enterprise only. Free export capped at 1080p.

features.feature: Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve XML export
features.detail: Results page > select clip > 'Export to XML'. Zip contains the original video, an .xml (clip with captions, reframe and B-roll) and an .srt. Captions and emojis come through as overlays, not editable text. One short at a time.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro only; source videos up to 1.5 hours.

features.detail: Links: YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, Zoom Clips, Rumble, Twitch, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Dropbox, Riverside, Loom, Frame.io, StreamYard, Kick, Medal.tv, Apple Podcast, public MP4 URLs. Links must be public or unlisted. Local upload. Optional SRT upload with the video. Source up to 10 hours.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: YouTube and local only, 10GB per file. Starter adds Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, Rumble, StreamYard, 30GB, MP4 URLs. Pro: all sources.

features.detail: My projects > 'Auto Import': connect YouTube, choose whole channel or specific public playlists. Modes: 'Notify via email' (manual approve) or 'Auto create projects' (processed with saved clip settings and last-used model; Auto headline optional). Checks hourly. Only own public videos over 3 minutes uploaded after setup; excludes private, unlisted, Shorts and livestreams.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter and Pro. Credits charged on full video length.
features.notable: Watch-a-source then auto-produce pattern; Content Studio could watch a creator list and pre-build remixes.

features.detail: Schedule from the results page or 'Calendar' in the left nav: pick a date, select clips and platforms, AI auto-generates descriptions and hashtags. Local videos can also be uploaded and scheduled from the calendar. Cancel by clicking the post > 'Delete'. Scheduled posts continue if the browser closes or the subscription expires. No pause yet.
features.limits_or_cost: Scheduler on Pro; Starter posts to YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram.

features.detail: Results page 'Select' or calendar icon > 'Bulk Schedule'; tick clips or 'Select all'; enter an order number per clip; set date and time of the first post and a 'Frequency' interval (for example 2 hours, 4 hours, daily; runs through nights and weekends); AI writes descriptions and hashtags; preview, edit, 'Schedule'.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro only; no clip count limit. FAQ says YouTube only (docs inconsistent).
features.notable: Order plus fixed interval is a simple drip pattern for turning one remix batch into a week of posts.

features.detail: Connect in 'Social accounts': YouTube, Instagram Reels (Business or Creator), TikTok, Facebook Page, LinkedIn Business, X, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky. Pro allows multiple accounts per platform. Rate limits: X 150/day, TikTok 4/min and 15/day, Instagram 40/day, YouTube soft limit 15/day, plus an OpusClip-wide daily cap.
features.limits_or_cost: X posts cost 3 credits per clip per X account, refunded if the post fails or is deleted.

features.detail: Type hashtags directly; TikTok hashtag trend search with usage counts; Instagram collaborator tags via handle in the description; AI-generated titles, descriptions and hashtags editable before posting (iOS); web checkbox 'Add the full video link to your YouTube post'. Custom thumbnail supported. API has a social copy generation job.

Owner creates a team (name, logo) from the profile menu and shares an invite link. Owner manages members, plan and billing; members submit videos on the owner's shared credits and share projects, brand templates and connected social accounts. Last save wins on concurrent edits. No ownership transfer, no per-member usage tracking, role assignment 'coming soon'.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro: 2 seats per pack, up to 4; Business unlimited seats, sub-teams, SSO.

features.detail: Endpoints: create project (URL or upload), get clips, brand templates, share project, censor job, transcript, thumbnail job, collections and export, social accounts, social copy job, publish, schedule, cancel scheduled post, webhooks, clip edits (trim, extend, caption typos).
features.limits_or_cost: Pro (Beta), Max, Business. 1 credit per minute, 10-credit minimum per API project, 15 hours per month on Pro Beta and Max, 30 requests per minute, 4 concurrent projects (Business 50), 10 h and 30GB per video, projects expire after 30 days.

features.detail: Hosted MCP at https://mcp.opus.pro/mcp with OAuth (no API key). 13 read tools (identity, usage, projects, clips, collections, templates, social accounts, scheduled posts, transcripts, on-screen analysis), 14 write tools (submit URL, upload link, edit clip incl. captions, filler and pause removal, trim, reorder, dubbing, undo; censor; share; collections; export; duplicate; social copy; post, schedule, unschedule), plus 2 thumbnail tools. Write calls need approval. Separate Claude.ai connector with workflow tools that require confirming publish inside OpusClip.
features.limits_or_cost: Tool calls need Pro Beta, Max or Business; 15 h/month and 900 credits per workspace on Pro Beta and Max.
features.notable: Read tools are free and unapproved, write tools require approval; a clean split Content Studio can mirror for an adviser's assistant.

features.detail: Generates new video from a prompt, pasted script (up to 1,700 words in Standard and Standard+), article text, audio (Audio to video, Song to video up to 120MB), a reference video (Reference to video beta, MP4/MOV/WebM up to 500MB) or product images (Assets to Ads). Up to 8 image assets labelled Object, Character or Logo, referenced with '@'. Quality modes: Standard, Standard+ (narrated explainers up to 10 min), Premium, Ultra (multi-shot scenes, dialogue with lip sync, photoreal, up to 3 min). Aspect 9:16 (default), 16:9, 1:1. Styles: preset, saved, or Auto; Style Maker builds a style from up to 8 images or one video. Custom mode picks video and image models (examples Vidu Q3, Seedream 5.0 Pro). Does not clip or caption raw footage.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits per second: Standard 1, Standard+ 3, Premium 7, Ultra 12 (30 s = 30/90/210/360). Premium and Ultra need Pro or Max. Free 60 one-time credits, Pro 300/month, Max 1,500/month. Free downloads watermarked.
features.notable: Per-second pricing by quality tier shown before you commit, plus a prompt guide with structured fields (topic, audience, tone, must-include points, source text, assets); a model for Content Studio's Remix brief form.

features.feature: Agent Opus voice clone and character assets
features.detail: Standard and Standard+: preview built-in voices, clone a voice from a sample up to 30 seconds (about 40 languages), or upload a spoken recording. No dedicated avatar feature; uploaded Character images appear in scenes and Premium/Ultra support character dialogue with lip sync. Pricing page says Pro and Max add 'custom avatars and voice clones'.
features.limits_or_cost: Voice clone not available in Premium/Ultra. Plan split between Pro and Max unverified.
features.notable: 30-second voice sample is a low bar for an adviser's own voice in remixed scripts.

features.detail: Standard and Standard+: timeline editor where you select a range (by timestamp or screenshot), describe the change, preview, then apply; version history; 'Reimagine' makes a new version in another style while keeping the original. Premium and Ultra: edit through project chat within 30 days. Each video includes one free retry for an edit that missed the request.
features.limits_or_cost: Each edit priced separately and quoted before approval; failed generations release reserved credits; edits that do not match are not refunded beyond the one free retry.
features.notable: Quote-before-apply plus one free retry is a fair billing pattern for AI edits.

features.detail: Connect a YouTube account (playlists or channels auto-imported and indexed) or upload. Indexes transcript, topics, speakers, mood and key moments across the whole library. Plain-language or exact-phrase (quoted) queries; filters People, Topics, Mood, Duration; sort Relevancy, Recently added, Oldest added. Results are clip cards; Select mode for bulk export; Collections by campaign or theme; 'Trends' shows topics gaining traction in your library.
features.limits_or_cost: Desktop only; plan detail sparse (Collections on Trial, Pro, Max, Business).
features.notable: Moment-level search with mood and topic filters is the right shape for a Content Studio library of proven adviser content.

features.detail: 1 credit per imported source minute (under 1 minute = 1 credit, partial minutes dropped). Processing timeframe slider reduces cost. Monthly credits expire in 60 days (one month rollover); yearly credits granted up front and valid 12 months; on cancel, credits keep original expiry. Team members spend the owner's credits. Extra packs add 300 credits and 2 seats.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 60, Starter 150, Pro 300 credits per month.

features.detail: Free Trial and Free Plan clips carry an OpusClip logo watermark (animated caption templates marked 'With watermark'). Upgrading to any paid plan removes it automatically, including from earlier free projects.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter and above watermark-free.
features.notable: Retroactive watermark removal on upgrade is a strong upgrade nudge.

features.detail: Upload or paste a link, set Clip Preferences, click 'Get AI clips'. Preferences: 'Clip preferred length' (multi-select, options include '<30s', 'Auto', '60s-90s'; shorter gives more clips), 'Ratios' (9:16, 1:1 or both), Styles 'Emojis' and 'Highlight words', 'Templates' ('Default' AI styling or 'Custom' brand template). If a custom layout does not fit (for example no screenshare), AI falls back to a speaker-first layout. Homepage claims 30+ clips per long video.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per minute. Works best on speech; 15+ minute sources recommended.

features.detail: Video understanding model analysing visuals (objects, scenes, characters), audio (speech, music, SFX) and sentiment. Type a prompt to find specific moments; it extracts and orders matching clips. API equivalent is 'keywords' (for example 'Find where Sam talks about GPT-5'); if nothing strictly matches, no clips return. API 'clipModel' clip_v1 or clip_v2 (v2 charged 1.25x).
features.limits_or_cost: Up to 10 prompts per project; re-prompting free during beta; new projects use credits; access may need support request.

features.detail: Each clip returns 'viralScore' on a 0-10 scale plus 'viralReason' (text explaining why it may engage), AI 'title', 'transcript', 'relatedTopic' keywords and a 'clipEditorUrl'. Clips are sorted by viral score. Starred and disliked flags.
features.limits_or_cost: Clip download URLs expire after 7 days (re-query for a fresh link).
features.notable: A plain-language reason next to the score explains why a piece works; Content Studio should show this on every inspiration card.

features.detail: AI Clipping reframes around the key subject for vertical. Ratios: 9:16 (default), 1:1, 4:5, 16:9. 'Change ratio' one click in the editor. Help articles cover Zoom recordings where screen and speaker need separating and wrong-person framing in multi-person video.

Auto subtitles on by default; AI emojis and AI highlight keywords off by default (API switches). Editor: edit emojis inside subtitles, turn off emojis, remove subtitles, merge/split/add subtitle lines, add a subtitle file to a video. Download transcript as TXT (Free) or TXT and SRT (paid).

Transcription in 40 languages per help center (API list shows 36 including Malay, Tamil, Mandarin Simplified, Mandarin Traditional, Cantonese, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese). Subtitle translation into 128 languages. Dubbing not mentioned.
features.limits_or_cost: Subtitle translation on paid plans per pricing table (checkmarks not readable; unverified for Free).
features.notable: Covers all four Singapore working-language groups (English, Mandarin, Malay, Tamil) plus Cantonese; a must-match for SG advisers.

features.detail: 'removeSilenceSwitch' removes silent gaps and filler sounds such as 'um' and 'uh' (API default off). Pricing page metadata references 'Remove bad takes' (unverified in app).

AI B-roll toggle (API 'autoBrollSwitch', default off). AI headline overlay on by default ('headlineSwitch'); template controls headline style and placement and can disable it. Short-video edit mode (under 3 minutes, 'getClips=0') adds subtitles, B-roll, emojis, headline, background, logo or outro to an existing short.
features.limits_or_cost: Edit mode input under 3 minutes (error 4005 otherwise).
features.notable: Edit mode on an existing short is exactly Remix's last step: take an adviser's recorded short and dress it in their template.

features.feature: Text-based editor, scenes and cover page
features.detail: Edit by text: delete transcript text to trim. Create clips manually by selecting text in the original video's editor. Extend AI clips with more content, access the original video, add scenes, timeline fine-tuning to the second. Cover page: a separate first scene with an uploaded image, or headline-only by turning off 'apply to all scenes' and deleting other headlines. Custom thumbnails for publishing.
features.limits_or_cost: Full editor on Free.

features.detail: Beta. Pick a portrait 9:16 talking-head video (15 s to 3 min, speaker detected) by upload or 'Select from project' (reuses the clip's reframe, transcript and scenes), choose an editing style; AI adds transitions, B-roll, zooms and effects. Output viewed and downloaded on the results page; resubmit for a different result. Best for knowledge sharing, opinion, tutorial content.
features.limits_or_cost: 0.5 credits per second (30 s = 15 credits); estimate shown before submit; failed runs refunded. No custom styles, no bulk, no auto-schedule, no API yet.
features.notable: Closest feature to Content Studio's Remix output step for adviser talking heads; style picker plus per-second estimate.

features.detail: On 'Save & Export' choose 1080p, 2K or 4K and turn on 'AI Enhance' (super-resolution rebuilding faces, hair, text). Applies to the export only. Exports at 720p or below are processed to at least 1080p.
features.limits_or_cost: Paid plans only. Credits per second: 1080p 1, 2K 1.5, 4K 2 (60 s = 60/90/120). Files over 500MB may fail; must reselect each time.

features.detail: Templates control subtitle font, size, colour; headline style and placement; logo position; background layers, animations and transitions. Template ratio must match clip ratio. Pricing table rows: Custom outros, Custom templates, Brand templates, Brand kit, Custom fonts. Template IDs from Edit > Template tab can be passed via API.
features.limits_or_cost: Brand kit on Business.

features.detail: Left sidebar 'Calendar' > 'New post' or click a slot ('+' in month/week view); choose exported videos, select accounts ('Manage accounts' to connect more), AI writes descriptions and hashtags (regenerate by adjusting tone and voice), confirm. Views: Month, Week, Feed. Drag posts to reschedule; Edit and Delete from the post or 'More' menu.
features.limits_or_cost: Scheduling on Creator and Business.

features.detail: At upload choose 'One click viral shorts', turn on 'Auto schedule and post', pick accounts, set Posting Preferences: minimum viral score, 'Post limit per day', 'Post schedule' (until batch finished, or specific weekdays), 'Post start date', 'Time to post' window. Click 'Get AI clips & Schedule'. AI writes a caption per clip and emails you when scheduled. Error state: 'No social-ready clips found to proceed with auto-scheduling'.
features.limits_or_cost: Up to 10 clips per day; all users per help article.
features.notable: Minimum-score gate plus daily cap plus weekday rules is a complete autopilot spec; Content Studio could apply it to remixes awaiting compliance approval.

features.detail: A saved 'Default Prompt' for AI social captions covering tone, emoji use, hashtags and CTAs ('Add default'). Regenerate all descriptions for a video or one account's description ('Platform Tweaks'). API 'post' empty string lets AI write the copy; YouTube 'title' AI-generated if empty.
features.limits_or_cost: Regeneration limits not stated.
features.notable: A saved caption voice prompt is the text twin of a brand template; maps to Content Studio's voice profile.

features.detail: Connect TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Instagram (Business or Creator), Facebook Pages. Help lists per-platform limits: TikTok 2 videos/min, Instagram 50 Reels/24h and 30 hashtags, X 100 posts/day and 280 chars, Facebook 25 posts per Page/24h, LinkedIn 150/day and yearly reauthorisation, YouTube Shorts under 3 min and owner-only connection. Option to add the long-form YouTube link to Shorts.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: TikTok only, 1 account. Creator 6 accounts. Business 20.

features.detail: Download, share as a link, or publish. Export directly to Google Drive. Manage view access of exported videos. Export quality: Free 720p, paid up to 4K; export length 10 minutes on Free, any length paid. Upload quality 1080p Free, 4K paid; clips keep source resolution.
features.limits_or_cost: Storage: Free 3 days, Creator 100GB, Business unlimited while subscribed.

features.detail: Business plan shared workspace: 'Invite' top right, enter emails, invites sent by email; switch between workspaces; real-time viewing; share previews with clients; project share links (API 'shareLink' Business/Team only). Desktop browser only.
features.limits_or_cost: $5 per seat per month; seats added mid-year prorated on a separate monthly invoice.

features.detail: Submit a long video for clipping (videoType: 1 remote file, 2 YouTube, 3 Google Drive, 4 Vimeo, 5 StreamYard, 6 TikTok, 7 Twitter, 9 Twitch, 10 Loom, 11 Facebook, 12 LinkedIn, 13 Dropbox, 14 Instagram; lang or auto; preferLength 0 auto or ranges 1-4; maxClipNumber 1-100) or a short for editing; poll results; list social accounts; generate AI social caption; publish or schedule ('publishTime' Unix timestamp).
features.limits_or_cost: Included in paid plans, uses upload minutes. Max 600 min and 10GB per video, mp4/3gp/avi/mov, up to 4K. Rate limits: Free 1/min 10/h, Creator 3/min 20/h, Business 10/min 60/h.

features.detail: New prompt-driven product at agent.vizard.ai ('One AI, Every Video Job'). Homepage lists 22 templates including Product ad, Software ad, Tutorial, Podcast clips, Listicle, AI avatar, Trailer, Music video, Documentary. Inputs, outputs and pricing unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Template gallery as the entry point to an agent ('pick a job, then prompt') is a good pattern for Content Studio's Remix start screen.

features.detail: Text-to-video and image-to-video inside Vizard using Seedance, Veo 3, Sora 2, Kling, Wan 2.2 and Nano Banana Pro. Seedance outputs up to 1080p; results editable in the Vizard editor.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses Vizard credits; per-generation cost unverified; free users get trial credits.

features.detail: Free 60 credits/month with watermark, 720p, 60-min/1GB uploads, 3-day projects. Creator and Business from 600 credits/month, 15 yearly credit tiers 7,200-74,400, 600-min/30GB uploads, 4K, no watermark. Credits: 1 per minute for clipping or transcription, charged once per project; unused monthly minutes accumulate. Payment by card, PayPal, Stripe, bank transfer; cancel in 'Workspace-Subscription'.
features.limits_or_cost: Creator $14.50/mo yearly; Business $19.50/mo yearly plus $5/seat/mo (third-party snapshot and help example).

features.detail: 'Drop a file or paste a link from YouTube'. AI extracts the best topics and edits them into many clips; homepage says 'a one-minute long video produces about 5 video clips'. Speech-dependent ('relies heavily on speech detection'). API defaults: target 10 clips, max 10, durations 1-180 s with target 60 s; optional 'transcription_context' up to 1,000 chars. Sources up to 4 hours (tool page) or 5 hours via API.
features.limits_or_cost: Source caps per plan: 45 min Basic, 2 h Pro, 3 h Pro+ (Klap blog). Pro processes up to 10 h of source per day.
features.notable: A free-text 'transcription_context' field (names, jargon) is a simple way to fix finance terms.

features.detail: Every clip gets a Virality Score and the strongest are surfaced first. API project objects include 'virality_score' and 'virality_score_explanation'. Reviewer says the top three often need manual reordering.
features.limits_or_cost: Score scale unverified.

features.detail: Content-aware reframe that follows the active speaker or a saliency point and handles shots without faces (products, screen recordings). Detects scenes and applies layouts: split screen, picture-in-picture, 3-screen, 4-screen, screencast, gaming. API 'reframe' on by default; dimensions default 1080x1920.
features.limits_or_cost: Aspect ratios 9:16, 1:1, 16:9 (reviewer).

features.detail: Auto captions (claimed 98% accuracy) in 52 languages with animated keyword highlights, speaker distinction, adjustable font, size, colour and placement, frame-accurate editing. API toggles: captions on, emojis on, intro_title on, by default. Reviewer lists styles bold, minimal, colourful.
features.notable: Emojis and an intro title default to on in the API; Klap assumes the styled output is wanted.

features.detail: Build a style in the editor (captions, fonts, colours, logo), save as a preset, '...' > 'Copy id', pass as 'style_preset_id' via API with per-request overrides. Each team workspace has its own kit applied automatically to all clips. Export watermark object: image URL, x/y position 0-1, scale.
features.limits_or_cost: Brand kits on paid plans.
features.notable: Preset ID reusable from API and UI: the same brand object drives manual and automated output.

features.detail: Full editor on every plan: import your own media, layer B-roll, make precise cuts, longer projects; preview, trim, swap or reposition B-roll. Reviewer notes no transitions, effects or multi-track and a sluggish editor.
API 'remove_silences' editing option, default false. In-app control label unverified.
Translates and re-voices video into 29 languages with lip-sync on by default (third-party review); strongest in Spanish, Portuguese, French, German; Asian languages show visible drift.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and Pro+ only (Klap blog). Credit per dub not disclosed.

features.detail: Upload or YouTube link, auto-detects source language, translates speech into subtitles in one of 52 languages; download with burned-in subtitles or separate subtitle files. API 'translate_to' parameter.

Publish and schedule to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn (API also Facebook) with unlimited social accounts on every plan. API caption writer takes 'tone' (casual default; professional, funny, inspirational, educational) and an optional prompt up to 1,000 chars; one platform-agnostic caption. Per-platform fields: YouTube visibility and category, TikTok privacy_level (user must choose), LinkedIn PUBLIC or CONNECTIONS, Instagram share_to_feed. Captions up to 2,200 chars, YouTube title 100.
features.limits_or_cost: Up to 1,000 posts per batch request; one post per clip per platform.
features.notable: Tone dropdown plus free-text prompt for captions is a compact voice control.

features.detail: 'Analytics' listed on all plans on the pricing page. What is measured is unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.feature: REST API, OAuth and usage pricing
features.detail: Base https://api.klap.app/v2, Bearer key. Tasks: video-to-shorts (max 5 h input) and video-to-video caption/reframe (max 15 min); status processing, ready, error; exports; webhooks. 'Sign in with Klap' OAuth bills the user's own subscription. Zapier, Make and n8n integrations; MCP server listed in footer (details unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: $0.44 per video input, $0.32 per short, $0.48 per export. API open on every plan per Klap.

features.detail: Create guest sub-users ('POST /users', isGuest true), act on their behalf with 'X-On-Behalf-Of', mint an external access token and embed the editor at app.klap.app/embed/{project_id}; preview player at klap.app/player/{project_id}.
features.notable: Embeddable editor with per-user tokens could let Content Studio offer clipping without building an editor.

features.detail: Workspaces per client with role-based access (admins, editors, viewers), activity log of who clipped what, review links for stakeholders, bulk download, calendar scheduling of top-scored clips. Enterprise adds SOC-2, audit logs, SSO, SLA.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro+ labelled 'For teams'; seat counts unverified.

features.detail: Free: 1 video, no credit card, no watermark (tool page FAQ). Basic/Pro/Pro+ at $29/$79/$189 monthly or $14/$39/$94 per month yearly. Unit is clips (100/300/1,000) on the pricing page and Klap blog, or minutes (300/900/2,700) per a September 2026 competitor article. Basic: HD; Pro and Pro+: 4K and dubbing.
features.limits_or_cost: Billing unit currently in flux; confirm at checkout.

features.detail: Upload a video, pick the spoken language and number of speakers, then click 'Generate Captions' (about 40 s). Pick a template, then adjust text color, font, weight, size and emojis. 'Edit Captions' fixes words, moves or resizes captions and highlights words. Animation highlights, bounces and fades word by word. The API lists 42 template names, including Sara (the default), Hormozi 1-5, Karl, Ella, Beast, Maya and Iman. Caption position is set by API as captionPositionY 0-80 percent from the top and captionPositionX 0-100. Vertical exports keep captions in platform safe zones. A custom dictionary takes up to 100 terms per request, and the account keeps the last 1,000.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and Business can create custom templates (counts conflict on the pricing page: 3, 5, 10 or unlimited). Language count is inconsistent: 123, 100+ and 48+ all appear.
features.notable: A dictionary of brand terms is worth copying. Advisers need product names and 'CPF' or 'MediShield' spelled right every time.

features.detail: Optional 'Trim' step. Click 'Remove Silences' or 'Remove filler words'. Deleting transcript text cuts the matching video. The API exposes removeSilencePace with three values: natural (cuts silences of 0.6 s or more), fast (0.2-0.6 s) and extra-fast (0.1-0.2 s).
features.limits_or_cost: All plans ('AI Remove bad takes and silences' is listed on every plan).
features.notable: A three-step pace setting is simpler than a millisecond slider and maps to how fast the speaker should feel.

features.detail: 'Remove Bad Takes' in the Trim step drops repeated or failed takes automatically. The API flag removeBadTakes defaults to false.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans.
features.notable: Advisers recording scripted takes on a phone often restart lines, so this removes the most tedious cut.

features.detail: 'Generate Hook Title' writes an on-screen hook for the opening, with editable text, font, style and duration. The API takes hookTitle as true (AI writes it) or an object: text 1-100 chars, template (default 'tiktok'), top 0-80 (default 50), size 0-80 (default 30). There are 13 hook templates: tiktok, laura, steph, kevin, kelly, mark, logan, enrico, mike, devin, hormozi, masi, ali.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans ('AI Hook titles').
features.notable: A hook overlay as a separate, restyleable layer is a natural slot for Remix: keep the proven hook's shape and swap in the adviser's words.

features.detail: Applies zoom-ins timed to the transcript and audio to stress key moments. The page claims 6 zoom styles. The FAQ mentions progressive or fast zooms, and the B-roll page lists fast zoom, smooth zoom in, expo zoom and linear zoom. Click 'Magic B-rolls' on the B-rolls page to add zooms with B-roll and transitions, or click '+' on a subtitle line to add one by hand. The API flag magicZooms defaults to false.
features.limits_or_cost: Pricing page lists 'AI Auto zooms' for Pro. The feature page says one-click zoom is free (conflict).

features.detail: One click reads the transcript and inserts relevant stock clips. 'Change Media' swaps a clip. You can also search by keyword, upload your own clips, and set each clip's start and duration. Layouts are cover, contain, rounded, square, split-50-50, split-35-65, split-50-50-bordered, split-35-65-bordered, pip-top-right and pip-bottom-right (images get the first four). magicBrollsPercentage (0-100, default 50) sets how much of the video gets B-roll.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter gets free B-rolls and audio. Pro and Business get Storyblocks B-rolls and audio.
features.notable: A density slider (percent of runtime covered) is a simple control worth copying.

features.detail: Path: B-roll tab > click a B-roll square > 'Add Media' > 'AI B-rolls' or 'AI Images'. Write a prompt (scene, mood, style, camera angle), preview, regenerate, then insert. In the API, an ai-broll item takes a prompt of 1-2500 chars and runs up to 12 s.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan cards say credits 'Generate AI videos and AI images'. A third-party site says Pro has 6 AI credits and Business 15 (unverified).

features.detail: Sits at the top of the dashboard. Upload, choose one of 3 style templates, then click 'Auto Edit'. It adds captions, B-roll, transitions, zooms and camera moves, and handles pacing. The templates are Kelly (minimal), Karl (modern, balanced) and Ella (dynamic, bold). In the API, aiEditTemplate takes kelly, karl or ella.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan not stated (unverified).
features.notable: Three named style presets instead of dozens of knobs is the right default for non-editors like advisers.

features.detail: Dashboard: 'Get Magic Clips'. Input is a YouTube URL, an upload, or a public Google Drive link. Processing takes about 10-25 min and returns 20+ clips, each with a preview, transcript and virality score. Trim a clip on the timeline or by transcript lines, then add captions, a hook title and B-roll, then 'Export'. API options: minClipLength 15-300 s (default 15), maxClipLength 15-300 s (default 60), faceTracking (default true), templateName (default Sara). The webhook returns viralityScores with total, shareability, hook_strength, story_quality and emotional_impact (in the example, total 89 is the sum of the four).
features.limits_or_cost: Add-on subscription of USD 19/mo for 10 uploads (help center). Each API project costs 1 Magic Clips credit.
features.notable: A virality score broken into four named parts shows the user why a clip ranks high. Content Studio could score proven posts the same way.

features.detail: 'Clean Audio' removes background noise with AI. API flag cleanAudio defaults to false.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans ('AI Clean audio').

features.detail: Upload (long or short form), click 'AI Eye Contact' or 'Correct Eye Contact', and the gaze is redirected to the lens in seconds. You can add captions before downloading.
features.limits_or_cost: Listed as 'AI eye contact correction' on the pricing table, but the plan is unclear (unverified). Not exposed in the API.
features.notable: Fixes the main defect of advisers reading a script off screen.

features.detail: Add music from the trendy or premium library (filter by mood and genre) or upload your own. A volume slider balances it against speech. API music settings: volume 1-100, startFromTime (default 0), fade (default true). Sound effects come as 10 preset sounds (clicks, whooshes) or uploads. Effects are generated automatically with B-rolls, and the speaker icon on a subtitle line adds one per line. 'Transitions' go between scenes.
features.limits_or_cost: Sound effects are free per the FAQ. Storyblocks audio is on Pro and above.

features.detail: Upload a video or paste a YouTube link, pick a target language, review the transcript, style the subtitles, then download. The feature page says this is subtitles only, with the original audio kept and no voice cloning or lip sync. A help article mentions 'voice translations', which conflicts with that.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans ('AI Translate captions'). Language count is inconsistent (48+ or 100+).

features.detail: The aspect ratio selector sits under the preview player and offers 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5. Cropping is automatic when the ratio changes, and you drag the subject in the preview to reposition. Magic Clips adds faceTracking (default true).

Sidebar 'Brand Kits' > '+ Create brand kit'. Name it, then add logos, brand colors, background elements, graphic overlays and visual templates. You can keep many kits, one per brand or client. 'Save Preset' (from Export) saves a project setup for reuse, and the API applies it with presetId and has list, get and update preset endpoints. The help article title says presets carry theme, audio, logo and B-rolls, but the body does not confirm it (unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: Brand Kit is listed for Pro and Business. 'Add logos and brand assets' is on all plans.
features.notable: A preset that bundles caption theme, music and logo is the core of a 'my brand' layer for Remix.

features.detail: Inputs are an upload (MP4 or MOV, H.264 preferred, HEVC accepted, up to 4K source), a YouTube link, or a Google Drive link (Magic Clips). 'Export' offers 1080p, 2K or 4K at 30 or 60 FPS. There is no mobile app: the web app runs on desktop, and mobile browsers can upload.
features.limits_or_cost: Max 3,000 MB per file in the web app, and 2GB or 2 hours by API. Length cap per video is 2 / 5 / 30 min on Starter / Pro / Business. Max export is 1080p on Starter, 2K on Pro and 4K 60fps on Business.

features.detail: After editing, select platforms and set a date and time. AI pre-fills each platform's fields (titles, descriptions, tags, captions, first comments), and you can edit them. A live preview shows a mockup per platform with tabs. 'Publish Now' or 'Start Scheduling'. The web page lists TikTok, Instagram (Reels and Stories) and YouTube Shorts, with LinkedIn, Facebook and X coming soon. The API already publishes to YouTube (title max 100, description, up to 50 tags, pinned firstComment), TikTok (content max 2,200, privacyLevel, allowComment, allowDuet, allowStitch, commercialContentType, videoMadeWithAi), Instagram (reel or story, caption, firstComment), X (280), Facebook (5,000) and LinkedIn (3,000).
features.limits_or_cost: Free accounts get one 'Publish Now'. Scheduling needs Pro or Business. Profiles are 1 per platform on Starter and Pro and 3 per platform on Business.
features.notable: AI pre-filling each platform's caption and first comment, with a per-platform mockup, is worth copying. The TikTok 'branded content' and 'made with AI' flags matter for disclosure.

features.detail: Endpoints: List Published Projects (filters, per-platform status and analytics), Get Publication, Publishing Stats (totals across all connected accounts compared with the prior period, plus a daily time series) and Profile Stats (the same for one profile). The pricing page lists 'Publish and analytics for social'.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans per the pricing page. In-app UI not documented (unverified).

features.detail: REST API with an x-api-key header, upload or URL projects, a webhookUrl for completion, and autoRender=false to edit the transcript before rendering. An MCP server at https://api.submagic.co/mcp works with Claude, Cursor and Windsurf to create projects, run Magic Clips, export, publish, pull reports and list templates. Integrations: Zapier (5,000+ apps), Make, n8n, a Google Drive watch folder (drop a file, get the edit back in Drive) and Gumloop (syncs brand kits).
features.limits_or_cost: Rate limit 500 requests/hour, with HTTP 429 and retryAfter when exceeded. API credits: 1 per started minute, rounded up (61 s = 2). Plan API minutes: Starter 10 or 100 per month (pricing page conflicts), Business 100 per month. Packs from 250 min for USD 57/mo.
features.notable: The Drive watch folder is a zero-UI ingest path. An MCP server lets an agent run the whole pipeline.

features.detail: Pick an AI avatar, type the speech text, choose an AI voice (professional, casual or energetic), then generate a talking video. Uploading your own face is not mentioned.
features.limits_or_cost: Limits and cost not stated (unverified).

features.detail: Steps: 'Upload Your Video', then 'AI Frame Selection' (it picks the most engaging frame), then 'Choose a Template' (styled after viral creators), then 'Export and Upload' a YouTube thumbnail.
features.limits_or_cost: Price not stated (unverified).
features.notable: Auto-picking the best frame of the adviser's face as a cover is useful for Reels covers too.

features.detail: Real-time collaboration to review, edit and publish in one workspace. Seats: Starter 1 user, Pro 3 users, Business unlimited.
features.limits_or_cost: Priced per member.

features.detail: Web: Home > Edit, upload, then write a prompt for how to edit. Pick a style from the library, optionally add your own media and paste web links as context, then 'Create my video'. The plan screen has: Prompt (editing it rebuilds the plan); a 'Voiceover only' toggle (no AI actor faces); Outline > Recommended cuts (filler pauses) with 'Restore original' and per-cut 'Revert'; Apply edit style (Style, Edit intensity, Color); and Insert media ('Custom media' or 'Generate media', which uses more credits). Then 'Create project'. iOS: import, pick a style, pick a language, and AI edits. You can restyle any shot later and toggle 'Keep existing images'. There are 21 Premium styles (for example Analog, Blueprint, Magazine, Neon, Vinyl II) and 95 Basic styles. A voiceover can now be added from the edit plan (July 2026).
features.limits_or_cost: Source must be 3 min or less (feature table: 2 min on iOS, 1 min on web), one speaker, 9:16 or 16:9, and unedited. Costs 10-40 credits. Needs Max or higher, or the export is watermarked.
features.notable: An editable 'video plan' (cuts, style, intensity, media) shown BEFORE rendering is the best pattern here. It is the natural review step for Remix.

features.detail: iOS: in a project tap 'Chat to edit', type, and use the paperclip to attach media. Web: 'Chat' in the left toolbar. Click timeline elements to reference them (Shift for several), use 'Add annotations' to mark moments, and use '+' to import or generate image, video, sound, voiceover or music. Editing effort is Low, Medium, High or Ultra. Examples: 'Add chill background music', 'Replace the background with an attached image', 'Generate b-roll about X and add it to the first shot'. Follow-ups like 'make it softer' work, and you can keep editing while chat runs.
features.limits_or_cost: 2 credits per message plus 1 per action plus any generation cost. Max plan and up.
features.notable: Selecting timeline items to scope a chat instruction is a strong pattern for 'change just this line to my offer'.

features.detail: Over 30 preset templates on web (pricing page says 100+ caption templates on paid plans, 1 on Free). iOS controls: text color, emphasis color, active word color and background, caption background (padding, radius), AI color scheme, stroke and shadow. Emojis are added to keywords automatically (size, timing, position). AI Emphasis adds underline, emphasis or supersize. Split Words sets words per line and lines per page. Also custom font import, alignment, autofit, capitalization, punctuation hiding, and transitions (auto movement, auto scale, random rotation). Save with Templates > Custom > New Template.
features.limits_or_cost: Caption styles need a paid plan to export.

features.detail: Tap 'AI Trim' in the bottom bar. It removes pauses and filler words (for example 'uhms'). Review each segment, adjust it, then tap 'Trim'. It can run right after import. Manual trim works by dragging clip handles.
features.limits_or_cost: iOS only per the feature table. Plan not stated.

features.detail: Toggle 'Eye Contact' in the editing panel, or prompt the web editor. It finds gaze breaks (reading a script, side glances) and re-aims the eyes at the lens while keeping natural blinks. Tips: keep the script above or beside the lens and keep the eye whites visible.
features.limits_or_cost: iOS and desktop only, not web. Needs a paid plan to export.

features.detail: Tap 'Zoom' to auto-apply zooms to the most engaging parts, or '+' to add one by hand. Intensity is level 0, 1 or 2. Animation curve is Linear, Ease or Instant. 'Edit', 'Delete' and 'Delete All' manage zooms.
features.limits_or_cost: iOS only.

features.detail: 'Denoise' is an on/off control that separates voice from background (echo, wind, crowd), with no strength setting. 'Music' lets you choose a track, import one, or generate one from a prompt with the Soundraw 2 or Udio V1.5 models, then regenerate. Music has a volume control and ducking under speech. Sound effects can be generated. Generated music is cleared for commercial use.
features.limits_or_cost: Audio Isolation costs 2 credits/min. GenAI music costs 1-2 credits (ElevenLabs Music 10, Lyria 3 Pro 3). Sound Effects cost 2.

features.detail: Import or record, pick the spoken language, then the target language, then 'AI Dubbing' > 'Apply'. It keeps the natural voice and timing. Dubbed caption words and segment volume can be edited.
features.limits_or_cost: 31 languages. iOS and desktop only. Desktop translation is capped at 5 min.
features.notable: Useful for advisers serving Mandarin, Malay or Tamil speaking clients: Chinese and Tamil are in the list.

features.detail: Path: All Tools > 'Lipdub' > 'Import Video'. Confirm the original language, choose a translation language, and generate. Lip and face movement is synced to the translated audio. 'Add more' adds further languages. Select versions and 'Export', or 'Export All'.
features.limits_or_cost: About 31 target languages, including Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Tamil. Credit cost and length cap not stated (unverified).
features.notable: Batch output of one video per language from one source.

features.detail: Record yourself reading a provided script (about 10 s of footage for Mirage Avatar X), upload a selfie, or (since Aug 2026) upload an existing video. Enter a script and generate vertical or horizontal videos in your face and voice. Prompts change outfits and backgrounds or insert products. You can change the twin's language. 'Avatar Looks' saves reusable looks.
features.limits_or_cost: Max plan allows up to 30 AI Twins and 2 concurrent generations. Creating twins on web is not available per the feature table (iOS and desktop only).
features.notable: This is the 'their face' part of Remix: a short consented recording becomes a reusable twin with saved looks.

features.detail: Steps: choose a project type ('Prompt to video' or 'AI Ads', which builds a UGC ad from a website), enter a script, choose a community avatar, then edit and export. AI Echo: record or upload a voice memo, and the avatar copies its tone, intonation and pronunciation.
features.limits_or_cost: Script 10-800 characters. Video max 1 min. AI Echo audio max 1 min on iOS. About 28 languages.
features.notable: AI Echo (your own delivery driving an avatar) keeps the adviser's real voice and pacing without filming.

features.detail: Write a text prompt or audio prompt, and it returns a full talking video. The A-roll is a Mirage-generated actor talking to camera. B-roll images and video are generated, and transitions, sound effects, music, zooms and cuts are applied automatically. Projects can be organized in folders ('New Folder').
features.limits_or_cost: Prompt up to 1,000 chars or 30 s of audio. Uploads up to 100MB. 39 languages. 16 credits per 6 s of output.

features.detail: Pick a source (an uploaded video file or an existing Mirage project), create a new remix, then add one or more actors. Customize the script: write new, generate a different hook, translate, or have AI rewrite it from your instructions. Select a voice, 'Generate' audio, preview, regenerate and trim, then 'Generate' the videos. You get one video per selected actor.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits are charged per actor or video. Amounts and limits not stated (unverified).
features.notable: Closest public analogue to Content Studio's north star: source video in, new script, hook, voice and face out. A 'generate a different hook' button and one-to-many actor output suit A/B testing.

features.detail: Select 'Clips' on Home, add a video file or a YouTube or public link, optionally prompt for a topic or moment, and pick a caption style. On the video plan, set aspect ratio (convert to vertical or keep horizontal) and confirm intro titles, then 'Generate'. You get a ranked batch, typically up to 30+ clips, each scored, with the best first. Default length is about 30 s and adjustable. The number of clips cannot be set. Clips Chat (Aug 2026) asks for more or different clips from the same source without restarting.
features.limits_or_cost: Source up to 3 hours. Upload up to 10GB. Max plan and up.
features.notable: An optional 'what moment do you want' prompt before clipping steers the AI toward the offer or topic.

features.detail: Script Generator takes a description plus template, keywords, tone of voice, length and language (9 languages, including English and Vietnamese) and returns a ready-to-record script. Camera: countdown of 15/30/60/90 s, flash, flip, HD or 4K, 30 or 60 FPS. Teleprompter: paste or generate a script, scroll continuously or scene by scene, display in-app or via iOS push notifications, and undo the last segment to retake.
features.limits_or_cost: Camera and Teleprompter are iOS only. Scripts are on Basic and up.
features.notable: Script > teleprompter > auto edit in one app is the shortest record path for an adviser who will film themselves.

features.detail: '+' > 'Upload' (Photos or Files on iOS, device storage on Android) or 'New Project' > Upload on web. '+' > 'Import URL' takes YouTube or other links. Video: MP4, MOV, M4V (iOS). Audio: MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV. Up to 4K source on iOS and web. The manual editor supports 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5. Captions Cloud syncs projects across devices.
features.limits_or_cost: 60 min per file. The iOS manual editor is capped at 10 min.

features.detail: 'Export' > Advanced options: resolution, frame rate, bitrate (Auto recommended), Smart HDR (iOS only) and an SRT caption download. Hide captions to export without them. No direct social publishing or scheduling is documented (unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: AI features (AI Edit, caption styles, eye contact, music) need a paid plan to export. Max-only features on Basic add a watermark.

features.detail: One credit pool per plan, used by every generative feature. Credits are spent whether or not you export. Rollover is capped at 3x the monthly allowance. Downgrading forfeits the excess. Cancelling forfeits the balance at period end. Image generation costs 1-6 credits by model. Video generation costs 1-100 by model (Veo 2 is 100).
features.limits_or_cost: Free 60-200 one-time, Basic 200, Max 500, Frontier 1,400, Frontier 2x 2,800, Frontier 4x 5,600 per month.
features.notable: Showing a credit cost per model lets users pick cheap or premium generation.

features.detail: Mirage API: add captions to a video (list and retrieve caption templates), and generate avatar videos with Avatar X from an avatar catalog. Integrations are documented for Zapier, Claude, Cursor and Clay.
features.limits_or_cost: Captions cost USD 0.15 per input minute, rounded up. Avatar video costs USD 0.15 per output second in 6 s blocks.

features.detail: Import from YouTube, Vimeo, X, Facebook, Twitch, Rumble, Loom, LinkedIn, Zoom, Google Drive or Dropbox, or 'Upload a file'. Select the spoken language (wrong language means no clips). It finds hooks, energy changes, story pivots and emotional peaks, removes near-duplicates, and returns candidate clips cut at natural boundaries, reframed to 9:16 and captioned. Segments over 60 s also come out as 16:9 chapters. An editable word-level transcript sits beside the clips, and selecting a passage cuts a custom clip. Nothing is published until you choose.
features.limits_or_cost: Source up to 75 min (product page) or 5 hours (help center), which conflict. Files up to 5GB on Free and 15GB on paid. Free renders are 720p with a watermark, and paid renders are 1080p without one. About 1 credit per minute of source. Uploads are kept 7 days. Clips work in 20 languages.

features.detail: Each clip gets a score from 75 to 99. Tiers: 95-99 exceptional, 90-94 excellent, 85-89 very good, 80-84 good, 75-79 average and may need improvement. Each clip is rated on four categories: Trends (relevance and timeliness), Hook and Flow (completeness and engagement), Engagement (emotion and discussion) and Shareability. Clips are ranked, with the top near 99 and the rest spread down to 75. The docs say it is a prediction, not a guarantee.
features.limits_or_cost: Paid plans also show a predicted-retention score per clip.
features.notable: A floor of 75 means every clip looks shippable, which is a deliberate UX choice. Content Studio should show the four sub-scores to explain WHY a proven post works.

features.detail: Adds a 4-7 word AI headline, written from the clip's hook, over the first 5 s of every clip in an AI Clips project. Style: bold black text in a white rounded box near the top, clear of captions. It adapts to aspect ratio. At import, under 'AI Video Tools', toggle 'Open every clip with an AI headline' (the choice is remembered across devices). On a ready project use 'AI Tools' > 'AI headline'. Per clip, go to 'Edit' > T icon, where a layer badged 'AI headline' can be reworded, retimed or restyled. A reword survives template or ratio changes.
features.limits_or_cost: AI Clips projects only.
features.notable: A remembered default toggle at import, with per-clip override, is a good pattern for brand defaults.

features.detail: Word-level animated captions with adjustable styles, fonts and colours in 99 languages (the hero says 50+). The editor help covers adding emoji to captions, caption animation, sound on captions, a progress bar, B-roll overlay, music, split layout, aspect ratio change (16:9, 9:16, 1:1 on Lite), video position and video zoom. The editor runs in the browser.
features.limits_or_cost: Caption accuracy claimed at 85 percent on the editor FAQ. SRT download is paid.

features.detail: Scene-change detection keeps the active speaker in frame, marks transitions you can adjust or remove, and switches between camera angles for interviews and multicam footage. It is on by default at upload and cannot be enabled after processing.
features.limits_or_cost: Paid users only (the pricing page also lists it on Free, which conflicts).

features.detail: AI removes filler words, silences and background noise in the text-based editor.
features.limits_or_cost: Essential plan and up.

features.detail: Pexels-backed stock videos and images. It auto-matches relevant clips, and you can also search by keyword, drag and drop into the editor, and adjust when each B-roll appears.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan not stated (unverified).

features.feature: Custom clip by timestamp or transcript
features.detail: Cut your own clip by entering timestamps, or by selecting a passage in the transcript.

Upload a logo (transparent PNG), choose library fonts or upload your own, enter HEX colors or pick a palette from the 'brand kit generator', and upload a branded outro or customize a template. Apply the kit to templates in a few clicks. Reusable templates hold brand colors, fonts and logos.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth plan (custom templates, Brand Kit, unlimited branded video templates).

features.detail: Open 'Viddy' from a project's side menu. It reads the transcript (hooks, insights, quotes). Prompt it, for example 'Write a LinkedIn post from this video' or 'Summarize the key insights in 3 bullet points'. Outputs: LinkedIn, X and Instagram posts, summaries, YouTube descriptions, newsletters, blog outlines or drafts, clip titles and hooks, and SEO ideas. 'Improve with Viddy' rewrites tone or length, and 'Revert changes' undoes. Copy or download the result.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth plan. Credit use not stated (unverified).
features.notable: One video fanned out into text formats (caption, carousel copy, LinkedIn post) is a cheap win for Content Studio.

features.detail: Downloads > 'Publish' > 'Schedule'. 'Link' any unconnected platform, then write or generate a description. Upload a thumbnail or pick a frame. A mobile-style preview shows the post, but not the final template or subtitle style. Set date and time and confirm. 'Scheduled Posts' lets you edit, reschedule or delete. Platforms: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X and Pinterest. One video can be queued to all of them, with aspect ratio adjusted per platform. You can also schedule your own outside content (Essential) and post Instagram carousels.
features.limits_or_cost: Up to 40 social accounts, scheduled up to 6 months ahead. Free and Lite publish to TikTok only (Free is 25 posts/mo). Essential has 7 platforms. Growth has unlimited scheduling and bulk publishing.

features.detail: A named group holding one account per platform, to keep brands or clients apart. Settings > 'Manage Social Sets' > 'Add Social Set', name it, then connect accounts.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 free set, up to 5 sets in total (extra sets are paid, price unverified).

features.detail: On the Publishing page, write the post and pick platforms, then 'Send for Approval'. Choose 'Send for Approval only' (the creator publishes by hand after approval) or 'Add Schedule time and Send for Approval' (it auto-publishes at the set time once approved). Enter any approver email, including people outside Quso. The approver can view via the link without an account, but must sign in with that email to approve. Unscheduled approved posts sit in the 'Sent for Approval' tab. The workspace owner can publish without approval.
features.limits_or_cost: Needs a Team Workspace (at least one Team Member seat add-on). Reject, comment and status flows are not documented (unverified).
features.notable: An external approver by email with no account needed to view maps directly to a supervisor or compliance check for financial advisers before posting.

features.detail: A visual calendar grid for weeks or months of posts. Upload local media or pull from existing projects. AI suggests the best posting time per platform.
features.limits_or_cost: Essential plan and up.

features.detail: One dashboard across connected platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, X). Metrics: engagement, engagement rate, reach, impressions and follower growth, plus top posts and audience demographics (location, interests). Includes a Social Score with suggestions, custom shareable reports, and benchmarking against competitors or industry.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth plan ('advanced AI analytics').

features.detail: Each uploaded minute costs 1 credit. Anything under 1 min is rounded up to 1, and partial minutes round up. Editing, publishing and downloading are free. AI video generation costs about 1 credit per output minute. Credits for failed processing are refunded automatically. Team credits are shared and only the owner buys the plan.
features.limits_or_cost: Monthly credits do not roll over. Annual credits arrive upfront and reset after 12 months. Add-on credits cost USD 0.15 each and never expire. Plans are non-refundable.
features.notable: Charging on upload only, with edits and re-renders free, removes fear of iterating.

features.feature: Script to AI Video and AI Influencer (being discontinued)
features.detail: Script to AI Video: paste a script into 'Add your own Script' or enter a prompt, then 'Continue'. Set Video Length, Voiceover Language, Subtitles Style and Background Visuals, then 'Generate Video'. AI Influencer offered 80+ stock avatars reading a script. Both help pages say the features are being discontinued.
features.limits_or_cost: About 1 credit per output minute.
features.notable: Signal that stock-avatar video did not stick for this audience.

features.detail: Record in short multiple clips so a bad take can be dropped. Settings: resolution and frame rate (up to 4K 60fps on some devices; FHD or 2K at launch), HDR or SDR, timer 3/5/10 s, speed 0.3x/0.5x/1x/3x, green screen, filters, screen light, beauty smoothing, flip and zoom.
features.limits_or_cost: Clips up to 10 min. Recording and editing capped at 10 min.

features.detail: Shows a script on screen while recording, with adjustable scroll speed and text size. A 2026 update lets sticky notes from the Ideas tab become teleprompter scripts (per search results).
features.limits_or_cost: Free.
features.notable: Idea note > teleprompter script > recording is a tidy chain from plan to shoot.

features.detail: Frame-precise timeline with layers for text, audio, captions, voiceover, stickers, sound effects, visual effects, transitions and video or image overlays. Press-hold and drag to reorder clips, drag yellow handles to trim, and 'Split' to cut. Volume and speed per clip. Keyframes animate position, focus and opacity of text, stickers, cutouts and overlays. The storyboard holds multiple takes for comparison (2026). Other additions: an adjustment layer for effects, project folders, saved text styles and clip lock.
features.limits_or_cost: Free.

features.detail: Toggle green screen in the camera or in the bottom menu for video layers. Pick a photo or video as background, then pinch to zoom and reposition the subject and background.
features.limits_or_cost: Free.

features.detail: AI subject isolation from a photo or video. Select a frame, tap 'Cutout', adjust the edges, and save. The cutout becomes a layer you can place over other media and animate with keyframes.
features.limits_or_cost: Free.

features.detail: Turns a still image into a short animated video clip.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. Reviewers report blurry, low-res results.

features.detail: Select 'Restyle' on a video and pick from 50+ presets in three groups: change the background or setting, change outfits or style of people, and change colors and lighting. Custom text prompts were promised for late 2025 (unverified whether shipped). Share directly to Instagram and Facebook. Restyle also reached Instagram Stories in Oct 2025 (per search results).
features.limits_or_cost: Works on 10-second clips. Free for a limited time at launch.
features.notable: Swapping an adviser's background or setting on a proven clip is a cheap brand-fit step for Remix.

features.detail: With no clip selected, tap 'CC Captions' > 'Add captions'. Fix words, change font, size, color and position, and delete wrong phrases. To exclude a clip from captions, set its 'Volume' to zero. Captions come in multiple languages. A July 2026 update auto-translates comments and captions into 15+ languages (per search results).
features.limits_or_cost: Free. Reviewers find timing hard to edit.

features.detail: 'Audio' adds trending or royalty-free music and sound effects, or imports from the phone. 'Volume Ducking' lowers music under speech. 'Voiceover' records narration onto the timeline. Also voice effects, voice enhance (noise removal), 'Cut silences', beat markers for syncing cuts, audio search filters, and clip audio up to 150 percent (2026, per search results).
features.limits_or_cost: Free.

features.detail: 'Text' gives fonts, themes, colors and animations (fade-in, typewriter), with shadow, outline and background, and saves styles as presets. Effects include transitions (fades, slides), filters, overlays, glitch, and 25 effects added in Jan 2026 (for example bounce, fisheye, blackout). Color has brightness, contrast and saturation. Templates are reusable formats, and the 2026 updates expanded templates tied to trending audio.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. The template library is smaller than CapCut's.

features.detail: Ideas: sticky notes for concepts, plus saved Reels, audio and collections. Inspiration: scroll Reels and save trending videos or audio. Since Jan 2026, Edits suggests up to 10 custom clip ideas each week based on the Reels you have shared.
features.limits_or_cost: Free.
features.notable: Weekly ideas personalised from the user's own past posts is close to Content Studio's 'find proven content' step.

features.detail: A live dashboard of Reels performance: skip rate, like rate, share rate, a retention graph showing where viewers drop off, and an engagement split between followers and non-followers, over the last 7 to 60 days.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. Instagram accounts only.
features.notable: Per-second retention and skip rate are what tell an adviser if the hook works.

features.detail: Tap 'Export' (top right), then 'Save to device' or 'Open in Instagram'. You can share directly to Instagram, Facebook, Stories or Messages. Export goes up to 4K (HDR where shot) with no watermark. Instagram itself posts at 1080p and converts HDR to SDR. No scheduling (unverified). Links to other Reels or Instagram accounts can be embedded in a clip and appear when posted to Instagram, but not external URLs (Jan 2026).
features.limits_or_cost: Free, with no watermark at any resolution.

features.detail: Every draft and video sits in the Projects tab, with folders since Aug 2026. Unpublished drafts can be sent via Instagram DM for feedback or approval. There is no co-editing, and projects are stored per device.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. Mobile only (iOS 16.3+, Android 9+). Needs an Instagram login, and deleting the IG account deletes Edits data.

features.detail: Opened from the Underlord icon in the right sidebar of any project. The user types a goal and Underlord reads the script, watches the video and acts on its own: adds captions, finds 60 to 90 second clips and reformats them vertically, adds zooms on emphasis or zoom cuts every 3 to 6 seconds, adds animated callouts, translates, applies Studio Sound, turns slides or docs into video with TTS or avatars, writes scripts from talking points, and does bulk edits such as centering every speaker, bleeping language or adding lower thirds to everyone. It can web-search for facts and brand colors. Model picker (cube icon): Auto, GPT, Gemini and Claude models; premium models need a paid plan. Example prompts: 'Edit this down to 2 minutes focusing on when I talked about Freud', 'Hide my jumpcuts by adding zooms'.
features.limits_or_cost: Each prompt costs AI credits for reasoning, plus the cost of any tool it runs; cost varies between runs. Charges show under 'Underlord' in the Usage tab. It cannot open or read a URL (paste the text instead). Limited on Free.
features.notable: Chat-driven bulk edits over the whole timeline are the closest analogue to a one-press Remix. Copy the pattern of a natural-language brief ('make this a 30s Reel for my offer') that then runs deterministic tools, with every tool charge itemised in a usage log.

features.detail: Skills are saved Markdown instructions with a name and description, run from Underlord chat via '+' > Skills or by typing '/'. A skill appears as a chip in the message, and the user can add context. Created from App settings > Skills > '+ New skill' (Underlord drafts it from a description, or you write it), or from inside a project via the built-in 'Create skill' skill. They replace prompt templates ('Save as skill' converts one). Each has a 'Try skill' button.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses AI credits like any Underlord request. Names up to 100 characters and unique. Private to the creator; sharing is not available yet. Saving overwrites the old version, and deletion cannot be undone.
features.notable: A saved 'remix recipe' per adviser (for example 'my weekly market update Reel') that runs with one slash command. Team-shareable skills are the gap Descript has not closed.

features.detail: Media is transcribed into a script (25 languages, speaker detection for 8+ speakers), and deleting or moving words in the script cuts the video. Scenes and layouts sit on top of the script for B-roll, multicam, titles and text.
features.limits_or_cost: Transcription uses media minutes (Free 60/mo, Hobbyist 600, Creator 1,800, Business 2,400 per editor). Still images count as 1 second.
features.notable: Advisers who are not editors can edit a talking-head video like a doc. This is the right base editor for Remix output.

features.detail: Fillers such as 'um' and 'uh' are auto-flagged in the script and underlined in light blue. AI Tools > 'Remove filler words' opens a list with timestamps and audio previews. Per instance: 'Delete', 'Delete and replace with gap', 'Ignore' (strikes the word, removes audio) or 'Remove from transcript'. The 'Avoid harsh cuts' toggle skips fillers that cannot be cut cleanly. It applies to the whole composition; to target one section, duplicate it to a new composition.
features.limits_or_cost: English transcripts only. AI credits, capped at 30 credits per file/tool application. Limited on Free.
features.notable: The 'Avoid harsh cuts' safety toggle and the per-instance review list both build trust before an automatic cut.

features.feature: Edit for Clarity and Shorten word gaps
features.detail: AI Tools > Sound Good > 'Edit for Clarity' tightens pacing and removes rambling, repetition and off-topic content. 'Edit intensity' slider: Low, Medium or Heavy. The optional 'Reword for flow' regenerates speech with each speaker's assigned AI Speaker. Removed words show as ignored text, and AI-generated words show in blue. Afterwards: copy edits to a new composition, remove ignored text (accept), or discard all edits. 'Shorten word gaps' is a separate AI tool that trims pauses.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits. 'Reword for flow' needs speaker labels and an AI Speaker per speaker.
features.notable: A three-step intensity control plus a non-destructive review (ignored text, not deleted) suits compliance-minded users who must check what was cut.

features.detail: An AI action that scans the recording for lines said several times and removes the bad takes, keeping one, in a single click. The changelog flow: Actions bar > 'Ask AI' > 'Remove retakes', then 'Apply Edits to Script'. Designed for recording from a script with multiple attempts per line.
features.limits_or_cost: Listed on paid plans (limited on Free). How it picks the kept take is not documented (unverified).
features.notable: Lets an adviser read a remixed script badly several times and still get a clean cut. This pairs well with a teleprompter-style recording step.

features.detail: Properties > Audio Effects > toggle 'Studio Sound' on a script layer or a multitrack track. An 'Intensity' slider controls strength. It can also be enabled while recording or in Screen Recorder. It applies at the file level, so every instance of that file in the project changes. Audio only.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits, capped at 30 per file/tool application. Does not work on TTS until the clip is converted to an editable audio layer. Files of 6+ hours or several GB process slowly.
features.notable: One toggle to fix phone or laptop mic audio is table stakes for adviser selfie video.

features.detail: Select the video layer > hover menu > Effects tab > 'Eye Contact', or toggle it in the Properties panel. AI redirects the gaze to the lens for footage recorded while reading off-screen.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits. One face only. Variable frame rate footage fails (re-encode to constant frame rate). It skips sections where the head turns or the eyes are far off-camera. Requires a network connection.
features.notable: Lets advisers read a remixed script off-screen and still look at camera, which removes the need for a teleprompter.

features.detail: Effects tab > '+ Add effect' > 'Green Screen' removes the background without a physical screen. Replace it with an uploaded image or stock background, or leave it transparent. The 'All Scenes' toggle applies a background across every scene, and the effect can be toggled without reprocessing. Chroma Key is offered for real green screens.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits. Keep other people and objects out of frame. Requires a network connection.
features.notable: Branded office or skyline backgrounds behind an adviser recorded at home.

features.feature: Center active speaker and Automatic Multicam
features.detail: 'Center active speaker' (Beta, AI Tools > Look Good) reframes a wide shot to keep whoever is talking centered; an on/off toggle is the only control. 'Automatic Multicam' maps audio tracks to cameras under 'Camera setup', with Style 'Automatic' or 'Show only active speaker' and Cutaway frequency 'Occasional' (every 30 s), 'Frequent' (every 10 s) or 'None'. A layout pack can be applied.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits. Center active speaker needs a clip with combined video and audio and does not work with multi-track sequences. Multicam overwrites existing scenes, and stopping midway does not undo changes.
features.notable: Useful for two-person adviser and client interview formats cut into vertical shorts.

features.detail: AI Tools panel > Repurpose > 'Create clips'. Set 'Number of clips' (1 to 20) and 'Length' (10 seconds to 5 minutes). Optionally choose a 'Layout' (portrait 9:16 and square 1:1 presets first, 'See more layouts' for packs) and enter a topic, goal or criteria, then 'Submit'. Each clip becomes its own editable composition in a folder named 'Clips from [composition name]'. Underlord can also do this from a prompt.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits (amount not published). Source must be longer than the requested clips; under 1 minute may produce nothing.
features.notable: A free-text 'topic, goal or criteria' steering field, and output as editable projects rather than flat files. No virality score.

features.feature: Quick Design (auto rough cut with B-roll)
features.detail: AI tools > Look good > 'Quick design' splits a single-scene script into scenes, applies layouts and basic styling, and optionally adds B-roll from stock and AI-generated media. Single option: B-roll on or off, then 'Continue'.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits. Single-scene projects only, so run it before adding scenes. Multi-speaker projects may get the wrong active speaker.
features.notable: One button from raw talking head to a designed draft with B-roll: the visual half of a Remix.

features.detail: Searchable caption style presets (sort by default, recently used or alphabetical, with a Legacy category). The scope toggle applies to the current scene or all scenes. Controls: font, size, alignment, text and background colors including gradients, stroke and outline, 'Active word' fill/stroke/background, 'Future words' fill/stroke, and line animation per word, line or paragraph. Use one captions layer per speaker for multi-speaker videos.
