features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited on all plans. Local export embeds subtitle tracks; burned-in captions need caption layers in the video. Translate captions covers 61 languages.
features.notable: Separate 'active word' and 'future words' styling is the current social caption look worth matching.

features.feature: Layout packs (incl. AI-generated from brand files)
features.detail: A layout sets a scene's speaker framing, fonts, colors, media elements and audio, grouped by type (Camera, Media, Chapter, Intro). Gallery packs are prebuilt. Custom packs: Remix a gallery pack's fonts and palette, generate one with AI (upload brand files plus a prompt, pick one of four AI design directions, get an editable pack), or build from scratch. Layouts place content by each file's visual role: Talking Head, Screen Recording, Graphics or Others.
features.limits_or_cost: Custom packs need a paid plan; custom font upload and custom packs are Creator and above.
features.notable: Brand files plus a prompt produce four branded design directions to choose from. That is a strong onboarding step for an adviser's look.

features.detail: Drive-level brand kit with tabs Assets (Google or uploaded .ttf/.otf/.woff fonts, named brand colors in every color picker, logo and Drive name for share pages), Layout packs (a default pack for new projects), Media (up to 500 shared assets incl. B-roll), Glossary (transcription glossary plus a 'Do Not Translate' list) and Permissions. Owner/Admin manage it, Editors use it, Viewers can only view.
features.limits_or_cost: Business and Enterprise only; Permissions is Enterprise only. One brand kit per Drive.
features.notable: The transcription glossary and 'Do Not Translate' list fit fund names, insurer product names and regulated terms in SG financial content.

features.detail: Click a speaker label > 'Assign avatar to [speaker]' > 'Create a custom avatar'. Methods: 'Text prompt' (Descript generates three options; you can add a style or reference image), 'Upload an image' (.jpeg/.png/.webp, max 10 MB, best in 16:9, front-facing headshot), or Stock gallery. Then 'Assign avatar' and, once the script is final, 'Generate avatar' to lip-sync to recorded or AI speech. Built on Kling Avatar models. Can be combined with Green Screen.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits, varying by model. Photos are safety-checked, and celebrities, minors and explicit images are rejected. One avatar per speaker.
features.notable: A single photo is enough for a talking avatar, so an adviser can 'appear' in a remix without filming.

features.detail: 'Add speaker' > 'Create speaker', then 'Enable speech generation' or 'Clone voice to enable AI speech'. Record yourself reading the consent statement aloud and 'Submit'; the clone is ready within minutes. Used to type new lines (TTS), fix a line without re-recording, or build a voice-over. Stock voices: 25+ on Hobbyist/Creator, 60+ on Business. Voice model is selectable in App Settings, including ElevenLabs options.
features.limits_or_cost: Consent statement must be read in English. Clones are based on US English, so accents may drift. You cannot add more training samples later. Clones of non-consenting people are not allowed.
features.notable: Voice consent captured by recording a spoken statement is a clean, auditable pattern for an adviser's own voice.

features.feature: Regenerate (fix take, change words, smooth jump cuts)
features.detail: Highlight a script section and click 'Regenerate'. Default in video projects is 'Audio & video' (regenerates the visual performance too), or choose 'Audio only'. Workflows: fix take (heal choppy edits), change what was said (needs an authorized custom AI speaker), and smooth jump cuts.
features.limits_or_cost: English only. Not for B-roll, sequences, multi-speaker shots or faces not clearly visible. Asks for consent the first time video is regenerated.
features.notable: Lets a remixed script swap in the adviser's own offer words on real footage without a reshoot.

features.detail: AI Tools > Repurpose > 'Translate'. Pick target language(s); a green dot marks ones already done. Check 'Dub speech' and assign each speaker a stock voice, with optional 'Lip sync', then 'Apply'. Each language becomes a new translated composition. Style: Auto (default), 'Match timing' or 'Direct translation'. Captions cover 61 languages; dubbing covers 30 (28 stock-voice languages, plus 13 'Recommended voices' languages on Business).
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits. Lip sync on Creator and above. Translation proofread on Business and Enterprise only. Re-translating overwrites manual edits.
features.notable: Chinese (Simplified) and Hindi dubs from one English recording fit Singapore's multilingual audience.

features.detail: 'Generate' button on an empty scene, or AI tools > generate media pane with Image and Video tabs, or ask Underlord. Inputs: text prompt, reference image, start and end frame. Options vary by model: Style, Aspect ratio, Number (images) or Duration (video), Resolution, and Audio generation on some models.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits, varying by model. Prompts and history are separate per tab. Video parameters cannot be set when generating via Underlord.
features.notable: Fills B-roll gaps when an adviser has only a talking-head clip.

features.feature: Aspect ratio, resolution and frame rate settings
features.detail: Box icon at the top-left of the scene editor. Presets: Landscape, Square, Portrait, Other (1:1, 9:16, 16:9 or custom). New compositions auto-snap to the nearest standard ratio. FPS: 23.98 to 60. Resolution: 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 4K.
features.limits_or_cost: Export cannot exceed the composition resolution. Free is capped at 720p, Hobbyist at 1080p, Creator and Business at 4K.

features.feature: Export and publish (local, web link, YouTube)
features.detail: 'Export' (top right) > Destination. Local export: MP4 or GIF at 480p/720p/1080p/4K, quality Low/Medium/High, audio normalization (LUFS -14 to -24), plus audio, transcript, subtitle and timeline exports (Premiere, Final Cut and others on Creator+). Web link: share page with an embeddable player. YouTube: title, description, category, tags, privacy, with chapters auto-converted. Podcast hosts and Google Drive are also supported.
features.limits_or_cost: Free exports carry a bottom-right watermark (re-export after upgrading). YouTube Shorts are not supported, and there is no scheduling. Shared or brand channels are not supported. Web-app only. Max length 1 hr (Free/Hobbyist) or 3 hr (Creator+). No direct TikTok, Instagram or LinkedIn posting; users have asked for it on the feedback board.
features.notable: The gap is real: no social scheduling and no Shorts publishing. A Content Studio that renders and schedules to IG, FB, LinkedIn and TikTok beats Descript here.

features.feature: AI credits and media minutes metering
features.detail: Two meters: media minutes (uploads and recordings; Rooms count session length, not participants) and AI credits (every AI tool, plus a few credits per Underlord chat message). Both reset each billing cycle with no rollover. The pool grows with each Editor seat. The Usage tab in Settings shows per-run cost and sells one-time top-ups shared across the Drive.
features.limits_or_cost: Studio Sound and Remove Filler Words cap at 30 credits per application. Other per-tool costs are not published. Top-ups are Creator and Business only.
features.notable: Capped per-tool costs (for example 'max 30 credits') make cleanup tools feel safe to press. A usage tab that itemises every run builds trust.

features.feature: API, MCP and Zapier access to Underlord
features.detail: Underlord can run outside the editor via a Zapier integration, the Descript API (command line or code) and a Descript MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants.
features.limits_or_cost: Pricing for API use is not stated (unverified).
features.notable: An MCP endpoint lets an assistant drive edits. Content Studio could expose Remix the same way.

features.detail: Template gallery led by 'Trending Templates', then categories Social, Holiday, Calendar, Anniversary, Record, Effects, Business, Industry, Insights. Each card shows a usage count (e.g. 2.2M), duration (e.g. 00:10) and a label (e.g. 'New trend'). On TikTok, a video made from a template carries a 'Try this template' link that opens the CapCut editor with that template loaded. The user swaps in their own media via 'Media' or stock and edits text, audio and background.
features.limits_or_cost: Free starter templates; premium templates need Pro. Template outros carry a CapCut logo clip (see watermark rule).
features.notable: This is the closest existing 'find proven content, press a button, it becomes yours' loop: the trend lives on the social platform and the template opens with one tap. A usage count on each card is social proof of what works.

features.detail: Per CapCut help, export itself adds no watermark. Branding comes from template ending clips (an outro with the CapCut logo), attribution-required stock assets, the default outro setting, or untouched template placeholders. Fix: delete the ending clip on the timeline (web, PC and mobile), swap branded assets, then export.
features.limits_or_cost: Third parties say free web export goes to 1080p with no watermark and that Pro removes branding more consistently (unverified). Newsweek reports some 1080p export options moved behind the paywall in Feb 2026.
features.notable: An outro clip as the 'watermark' is a softer, removable growth lever than a burned-in logo.

features.detail: 'Captions' > 'Auto captions' > pick the spoken language > 'Generate'. Captions land in the Subtitles tab for line and timing edits. The Styles panel offers caption templates (Glow, Trending, Aesthetic, Multiline), or 'Style captions with AI' lets the tool pick. Font, size, color, position and animation are adjustable. Your own SRT can be uploaded. Desktop adds bilingual captions and keyword highlighting.
features.limits_or_cost: Web upload for captioning under 20 minutes. 20+ languages on web. Described as free; a third party says free has a 10-minute auto-caption cap that Pro removes (unverified).
features.notable: 'Style captions with AI' (the tool picks a caption style for the clip) removes a decision for non-designers.

features.feature: Transcript-based editing and filler word removal
features.detail: Desktop: Menu > Layout > 'Transcript-based editing' generates a transcript. Deleting text deletes the matching video, with search and show/hide deleted text. In 'Captions' > 'Auto captions', the 'Identify filler words' toggle highlights um, uh, like and you know in the transcript; delete each one or adjust it manually.
features.limits_or_cost: Desktop only per the pages. CapCut calls it free, but third-party tutorials say filler and silence removal need Pro (unverified).

features.detail: Select clip > 'AI Tools' > 'Remove Silence', set a silence threshold (minimum gap length to cut), 'Apply', then review the cuts on the timeline before export. Works on iOS, Android and desktop.
features.limits_or_cost: Reported as Pro only, with no automatic silence detection on free (third-party competitor blog, Sept 2026; unverified).

features.feature: Long video to shorts (AI clip maker)
features.detail: Upload from device, cloud, Google Drive or Dropbox. AI Highlights picks key moments from speech patterns and cuts multiple short clips with adjustable length, auto captions and smart reframing from 16:9 to 9:16 with subject tracking. 'Preview' or 'Edit more', then 'Export' or share. Output labels include 'Get clips' and 'Save to timeline'. CapCut claims 10+ clips from a one-hour video.
features.limits_or_cost: Marketed as free with no watermark. No clip score or ranking is shown. No YouTube-link input is documented. Length and size caps are not stated.
features.notable: Clip generation, reframe and captions in one step. Missing a score, which is the gap VEED and OpusClip fill.

features.detail: Desktop: select clip > right panel 'Video' > toggle 'Auto reframe', choose 'Aspect ratio' (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16 and others), set 'Image stabilization' and 'Camera moving speed', then 'Apply'. Keeps the key subject centered.
features.limits_or_cost: Available in specific regions. Described as free to try.
features.notable: Exposing 'camera moving speed' gives control over how jumpy the auto-crop feels.

features.detail: Web: select clip > 'Smart tools' > 'Remove background' > 'Auto removal', or 'Chroma key' (pick key color, tolerance and edge softness). Desktop: 'Video' > 'Remove BG' > 'Auto removal'. 'Custom removal' brushes refine hair and edges. Replace with a solid color, image, video or AI-generated backdrop.
features.limits_or_cost: The membership help page says AI background removal needs an active membership even with credits. The tool page calls it free. Conflicting, so treat as unverified.

features.feature: AI avatar video (incl. custom avatar from your video)
features.detail: Web homepage > 'Avatar video'. Choose one of 100+ stock avatars, or upload a personal video of 10 seconds to 5 minutes to create a custom avatar. Enter a script or click 'Generate script' with a prompt, pick a voice and set duration, then 'Create'. Then edit the script, captions and music, and 'Export' (MP4/MOV) or 'Edit more'.
features.limits_or_cost: Free sign-up. Avatar text panel shows Pro badges in places. Credit cost not published. Seedance 2.0 avatar generation is priced per second on Pro/Ultra.
features.notable: A 10-second to 5-minute selfie clip creates a reusable twin, which suits putting an adviser's face on remixed scripts.

features.feature: Instant AI video (AI video maker, Seedance)
features.detail: Web: 'AI video maker' > 'Instant AI video'. Choose a style (Realistic film, Cartoon 3D, Cinematic movie), paste a script or 'Generate script', set aspect ratio, voiceover and duration, then 'Create'. Desktop adds a 'Scenes' panel to pick an avatar and voice per scene, 'Elements' for subtitles and 'Music'. An image can be uploaded as the first frame. Models: Seedance 2.5, plus Seedance 2.0 and 1.5 Pro.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro: up to 240 s at 720p or 600 s at 480p with Seedance 2.0 Mini; Seedance 2.5 from $0.12/sec (first month). Ultra: up to 1,700 s at 720p or 4,300 s at 480p; Seedance 2.5 from $0.18/sec (first month).
features.notable: Per-second pricing with explicit max-length-per-plan is clear and comparable.

features.detail: Choose 'Narration' (talking script) or 'Commercial' (enter product or service details), enter a prompt or pick from a drop-down, and get five script options. Pick one, then 'Generate video' ('Smart generation') for an auto result from stock footage plus voiceover, or 'Custom generation' in the multi-track editor with your own clips. Clean-up tools: AI People Remover and AI Text Remover.
features.limits_or_cost: AI Script-to-Video is listed as a credit-consuming feature. The tool page calls it free with no watermark.
features.notable: Five script variants before rendering is a cheap decision point. A 'Commercial' mode built around the user's offer maps onto Content Studio's 'rebuilt in their offer'.

features.feature: Text to speech and custom voice
features.detail: Desktop: 'Text' > 'Add Text' (or 'AI writer') > 'Text to speech' panel > pick a voice > 'Generate speech'. Web: 'AI tools' > 'Text to speech'. 200+ voices filterable by gender, age, style and language, including Chinese, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, English, Spanish and Japanese. A custom voice clone comes from recording a few sentences. Adjust rate, volume, pitch and fades. Audio exports as AAC, FLAC, MP3 or WAV.
features.limits_or_cost: 'Premium Voiceovers' consume credits. A third-party review saw a Pro badge on TTS in the web editor. Character limits are not stated.
features.notable: Malay and Chinese voices matter for Singapore audiences.

features.detail: Select clip > right panel 'Audio' > 'Voice effects', with styles such as robot, chipmunk, male and female.
features.limits_or_cost: Described as free. The full effect list is not published.

features.detail: Subtitle translation: 'Captions' > 'Auto captions' > 'Generate', then 'Translate', pick a language and press 'Translate'. 27+ languages. Dubbing: desktop 'Audio' > 'Video translator', set source and target language. It claims to keep the original speaker's tone.
features.limits_or_cost: Dubbing is available in specific regions only. Lip sync is not mentioned. Plan and credit cost not stated.

features.detail: Teams brand kit saves brand colors, logos and typefaces to apply across projects. Brand templates are pre-designed team templates that keep output consistent.
features.limits_or_cost: Teams plan (the pricing page lists brand kit only under Teams). In the web editor it is visible but gated behind a trial for non-Teams users.

features.detail: 1,000 GB shared team space plus 100 GB personal cloud per member, real-time co-editing, shared assets, and Pro features for every seat. Subscription credits are pooled at team level, while activity and purchased credits stay personal.
features.limits_or_cost: Per-seat pricing varies by seat count and region. Roles and approval workflows are not documented.
features.notable: Pooled team credits fit an agency or adviser-team model where a leader buys credits for reps.

features.detail: 1 credit = USD 0.01. Credits pay for premium AI: AI Image Generation, AI Script-to-Video, AI Portrait, Smart Cutout, Premium Voiceovers and Remove Background. Three types, deducted in order: Subscription (refresh each cycle, valid 30 or 365 days), then Activity (promo, 7 days, 30 days or permanent), then Purchased (valid 2 years). Buying credits requires a membership; some tools (auto-editing, AI background removal, advanced generation) need membership even with credits.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro 850/mo (SG page) or 550/mo (UK, July 2026); Ultra 11,112 or 6,830; Teams 850 or 1,200 per seat. Pack prices not published on the help pages.
features.notable: A fixed cent value per credit and a stated deduction order (subscription first, paid last) are easy to explain to buyers.

features.detail: 'Export' (top right): name, resolution, bit rate, codec, format and frame rate. Web free tier exports 360p to 1080p (no 4K); Pro adds 4K and HDR. Share directly to TikTok (set title, permissions and audience, then 'Share' posts it), YouTube, and on web also Instagram and Facebook.
features.limits_or_cost: 4K and HDR need Pro. No native scheduling in CapCut itself.
features.notable: Posting straight to TikTok from the export dialog with title and audience fields is the minimum publishing bar.

features.feature: Scheduling via Pippit (formerly CapCut Commerce Pro)
features.detail: Scheduling lives in a sister product, Pippit ('Powered by CapCut'). 'Publisher' > 'Authorize' social accounts, then 'Schedule' (top right of the calendar): pick the file, time and account, add an optional caption, and 'Schedule'. Posts appear on a social calendar. Export to TikTok can add a TikTok Shop product link. 'Analytics' shows follower growth, engagement and impressions for the last month.
features.limits_or_cost: Publishing supports TikTok, Facebook and Instagram. Analytics is TikTok only so far. Pricing not stated on the help page. CapCut's '1post' page reads as a template category, and scheduling there is unverified.
features.notable: ByteDance split editing and scheduling into two products. Content Studio can win by keeping Remix, the calendar and posting in one flow.

features.detail: 'Subtitles' > 'Auto Subtitle' (or 'Manual Subtitles', or 'Upload Subtitle File' SRT/VTT/TXT), select a language, and subtitles generate in seconds. Edit lines (Enter to split, 'Merge' to join). The 'Styles' menu covers font (default Roboto, custom upload), size, Text Color, Effect Color, preset Effects (e.g. 'Rounded BG'), Animation including Karaoke word highlight, alignment, capitalization (AB, ab, Ab), line height and spacing. A low-confidence word feature flags words to check. Download SRT, VTT or TXT via 'Options' > 'Download Subtitles'.
features.limits_or_cost: 125+ languages. Paid plans get unlimited subtitles with a 50 hr/mo fair-use cap. Subtitle file download is paid. Karaoke animation is English only.
features.notable: Low-confidence word flagging is a cheap accuracy aid, useful when captions contain fund names or figures.

features.detail: Subtitles > 'Translate' > '+ Add language', then 'Translate automatically', 'Manually translate' or 'Upload'. An eye icon under Languages switches between tracks.
features.limits_or_cost: Minute-based and counted against the plan allowance, with no rollover. Free can try automatic translation once, then upgrade.

features.detail: Select the clip > 'Magic Cut' (Video menu) > 'Continue'. It removes silences, filler words, repeated mistakes and awkward pauses, then joins the remaining segments. Fine-tune in Magic tools with the 'Remove Silences' and 'Filler Words' settings, or 'Edit with Script'. Cuts stay editable and revertible on the timeline.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans including Free. English only.
features.notable: One button for the whole cleanup pass (silence, fillers and retakes) is simpler than Descript's three separate tools.

features.feature: Clips (long to short) with per-clip scores
features.detail: Upload a long video or drop a YouTube link. Set 'Original language', 'Aspect ratio' (portrait or landscape), 'Video goals' (viral shorts, highlights or insights), an optional custom prompt ('the part where I talk about the new product launch'), clip length and caption style, then 'Continue with [language]'. You can close the tab; VEED emails when done. Speakers are auto-centered and subtitled. Each clip is scored out of 10 on Flow, Impact, Clarity and Relevance. 'Trim with Text' lengthens or shortens a clip by selecting transcript sentences. 'Edit' opens the editor, then 'Done' > 'Export Video'. Powered by Sieve.
features.limits_or_cost: Needs spoken audio; minimum input is quoted as 1 minute of speech on one page and 2 minutes on another. Roughly one clip per 3 minutes of transcript. Free to try; Pro for full access and watermark-free export.
features.notable: A four-part score (Flow, Impact, Clarity, Relevance) is more explainable than a single virality number. Combined with a 'video goal' picker and email-when-ready, it is worth copying for ranking inspiration.

features.detail: Click the clip > 'Edit Video' panel > 'AI Tools' > 'Eye Contact', or 'Eye Contact Correction' under 'Video' in the left panel. AI adjusts the gaze toward the camera and keeps natural eye color and blinks.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: one use per account. Creator, Pro, Studio and Enterprise: full access. Correction is disabled where the eyes are too far off-camera. Best on well-lit, close talking heads.
features.notable: A one-free-try trial on premium tools is a good taste-then-upgrade pattern.

features.detail: Editor 'AI Tools' > 'Clean Audio' removes background noise (hum, wind, static, echo) and evens out volume in one click, on video or audio files. Can be toggled off to compare.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: one use per account. Paid plans: full access.

features.detail: 'Video' tab > 'Talking Characters' > 'View All' to browse stock avatars, or 'Create New'. Then the 'Text' tab for the script and 'Generate'. The result lands on the timeline as a normal clip to trim and edit.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits per generation; regenerating charges again. Max 20,000 characters per generation. One avatar on screen at a time. Text is editable only if the clip has not been cut. Appearance cannot be changed by regenerating. Some legacy avatars are being sunset.

features.detail: Record about 2 minutes on webcam or phone, reading a teleprompter script; consent and voice identification are built into the recording. The avatar is ready within a few hours. Type a script to produce video; edit the script and regenerate only the changed sections. Translates into 30+ languages with lip sync. Built with Tavus.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan not stated on the blog. The help center says custom avatars are an Enterprise feature (unverified for current plans).
features.notable: Regenerating only the changed sections after a script edit keeps compliance revisions cheap.

features.detail: Open via veed.io/ai-dubbing, 'More apps' > 'AI Dubbing', or 'AI Tools' > 'AI Dubbing'. Upload (.mp4/.webm/.mov/.avi/.mkv). Source language is auto-detected from 70+. Pick a target language and an AI voice or your own, toggle lipsync (beta), then 'Continue'. Enterprise adds 'Upload Transcript' (SRT/VTT/SSA/ASS), 'Proofread' and 'Translate' from the uploaded text.
features.limits_or_cost: Free and Creator: try once. Pro 6 hr/yr. Studio 12 hr/yr. About 5 to 10 min to process a 20-min video; lipsync can take hours and downsamples to 1080p.
features.notable: Proofread before dubbing (from an approved transcript) is the right control for regulated wording.

features.detail: Select clip > 'AI Tools' > 'AI Voice' (or 'Audio' > 'AI Voice'). Pick a language (50+), then a voice under 'Actors' or your own under 'Voice Clone', and 'Generate'. Review on the timeline, or 'Download MP3' for audio only.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits on every plan. 5,000 characters per generation. One voice clone per workspace. Annual AI voice allowance: Free 10 min/mo (some regions), Creator 4 hr, Pro 144 hr, Studio 960 hr.

features.detail: Dashboard 'Brand' or editor 'Brand Kit' tab. Holds fonts, colors (HEX/RGB/HSL), images, video, audio and saved groups such as lower thirds, intros and outros. Add by bulk upload (auto-sorted), right-click a timeline item > 'Save to Brand Kit', or select items > 'Group' > 'Save to Brand Kit'. Fonts and colors appear in the pickers. Multiple kits support Move and Duplicate.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: none. Creator: one kit, fonts and colors only. Pro, Studio and Enterprise: multiple kits with all asset types. Any workspace editor can change kits.
features.notable: Saving a styled group (lower third with logo) straight from the timeline into the kit is a low-effort way to build reusable brand parts.

features.feature: Brand Fetch, brand templates and Brand Control
features.detail: 'Brand Fetch' builds a brand kit by pulling the logo, fonts and colors from a homepage URL. Any video can be saved as a template (intro, outro, B-roll) and reused. 'Brand Control' locks the kit so only approved users can change it, and brand managers can lock approved assets and assign owners.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan tiers not stated. Brand Fetch appears on marketing pages only, not the help article (unverified current status).
features.notable: Website-URL to brand kit in one step is the fastest possible brand onboarding. Asset locking suits firms that must approve logos and disclaimers.

features.detail: Sidebar 'Create asset'. Search or filter by Video or Image, category (Brand Campaigns, Viral Hooks, Product Ads, Creator Content, Product Mockups) and style (Minimal, Modern, Bold, Professional and others). Click 'Recreate this' on a template, which loads its pre-written prompt. Keep or edit the prompt, optionally upload a product photo or screenshot, choose model, aspect ratio and resolution, then 'Generate'. The asset stays in the workspace for subtitles, brand colors and voice.
features.limits_or_cost: Runs on AI credits. The cost is shown on the Generate button before running. Free can try within free credits.
features.notable: This is the Remix pattern almost exactly: a proven example, one button, a prompt pre-filled from the example, the user's own asset swapped in, and the cost shown on the button. The 'Viral Hooks' category is directly relevant.

features.detail: veed.io/ai-playground or editor 'Create' > 'AI Playground'. Text-to-video and image-to-video with Google Veo 2/3/3 Fast, Seedance, Minimax, Pixverse, Kling, Luma Ray, LTX and Wan (newer marketing adds Sora 2 and Veo 3.1). Set aspect ratio and model settings (length, style, resolution). The output can be downloaded or used in the project timeline.
features.limits_or_cost: Credit cost shows next to each model and again before generating. Credits are deducted only on success, so failures are free. Free plan: credits in some regions only, max 12 s files. Third-party burn estimates: in-house models about 2 credits/s, Kling about 6, Sora 2 about 12, Veo 2 about 50.
features.notable: 'Charge only on success' plus a visible per-model price removes the fear of paying for a failed generation.

features.feature: Text to video and script generator
features.detail: Describe a concept or paste a script, and VEED assembles footage (stock, your media or AI visuals), narration (voice-only or avatar) and auto subtitles. The script generator drafts hooks, key points and CTA from a short prompt. Article-to-video converts pasted text.
features.limits_or_cost: Full stock library needs a premium plan. Credit cost not stated (marketing pages only).

features.feature: Resize, background removal and background expand
features.detail: 'Settings' > 'Size' dropdown with platform presets (Instagram Story, TikTok, YouTube), 'Fit to Canvas' and drag to reposition. Auto-crop tracks and centers the subject. One-click background removal replaces with a color, image or video. AI Background Expand (generative fill) extends the frame.
features.limits_or_cost: AI Background Expand handles videos up to 1 minute. Plan gating not stated (marketing pages).

features.feature: Export, sharing and lack of direct publishing
features.detail: Export renders on VEED servers (you can leave the page). Pick a quality preset under Export Settings, then Download > MP4 (MP3 for audio). Projects can be private, public or 'Anyone with the link can view'. To repurpose across platforms, you pick a size preset, export and download each version, then upload manually. No native scheduler or direct posting is documented.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 720p with a hardcoded watermark (re-export after upgrading to remove it). Creator 1080p. Pro, Studio and Enterprise 4K. Output never exceeds source quality. FPS limits apply above 60 fps. Free upload cap reported as 1 GB per file (third party, unverified).
features.notable: Again a gap: VEED ends at download. Scheduling to the adviser's own accounts is a differentiator.

features.detail: Each plan includes an AI credit allowance that refreshes at renewal (annually on yearly plans) and does not roll over. There are no top-up packs; you upgrade instead. Billing is per seat, charged when you invite users. Cancel via 'Team Billing' > 'Turn off auto-renewal'. Free trial only for Enterprise with 3+ users.
features.limits_or_cost: Creator 6,000/yr, Pro 30,000/yr, Studio 180,000/yr (tracker figures). Credits are charged per action, so revisions burn credits again.
features.notable: The annual credit pool with no top-ups is a known pain point (users call the pricing confusing). Content Studio should show cost per Remix in plain terms.

features.feature: Agent Two with Lite / Pro / Ultra tiers
features.detail: Built-in AI agent that carries a project from script to final cut. User picks an intelligence tier per task: Lite (fast, credit-efficient, for sketching), Pro (premium quality, higher cost per generation), Ultra (quality upgrade on top of Pro, e.g. 4K video, upscaled images). Inputs: videos, scripts, PDFs, links, rough cuts, read against the project Context. Built on Claude, Gemini and GPT; Notebooks give direct access to any model. Users can build their own agents (Scriptwriter, Video editor, Colorist, Sound designer) or connect outside agents (Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Codex, Grok, Gemini).
features.limits_or_cost: Credits per exchange depend on models used. Starter plan gets Lite only; Plus and Max get Lite, Pro, Ultra.
features.notable: Exposing a cheap draft tier and a premium final tier lets users iterate without fear of burning credits.

features.feature: Generation approval modes and per-project spend limit
features.detail: Setting controls when the agent may spend: 'Always allow' (default), 'Ask before generating videos', or 'Always ask before generating'. When approval is needed a popup shows prompt, model, duration and aspect ratio, all editable before confirm. Three-dots menu on any message shows credits used by that exchange; 'Project Usage' shows the project total; a credit limit can be set per project.
features.notable: Approve-before-spend popup with editable model/duration/ratio is a clean pattern for a Remix button that may call paid video models.

features.detail: Inputs: product or app link (agent pulls product details, imagery, app UI), optional script (or agent writes several reads to choose from), creator brief (age, look, energy, setting, speaking style) or reference, past winning ads (agent analyzes hook, pacing, register), or 'any ad or trending hook to rebuild around your product', optional recorded voiceover. Flow: brief -> cast an AI creator (face and voice locked together) -> approve each shot as a still -> animate with voice and line-by-line lip sync -> agent scores, paces and stitches. Batch e.g. ten hooks with different angles on one creator; switch style (testimonial, unboxing, demo) without re-setup; rebuild a winner for a new market in another language. Export the ad or all assets for another editor.
features.limits_or_cost: Older help article: AI twin or virtual avatar in UGC Ad flow about 120 generative credits per ad of about 1 min (may be outdated). Current page gives no credit figure.
features.notable: Closest thing to Remix: upload a winning or trending ad and rebuild it around your own offer, with stills approved before expensive animation.

features.detail: In invideo Editor the user points the assistant at a reference video; it applies that reference's pacing, structure and style to the user's own footage cut.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses credits (amount not published).
features.notable: Style-transfer of edit rhythm from a viral reference onto the user's own footage is exactly the 'remix in my face' step.

features.feature: AI assistant editor: first draft and cleanup
features.detail: Drop in raw footage with or without a script. Assistant picks best takes, removes flubs, filler, silence and pauses, splits audio and video onto layers, flags script lines that were never shot, frame-matches multicam angles and switches to whoever is speaking, finds moments by person, emotion, action, object, scene or camera angle, adds chapter markers and exports transcript, subtitle file and chapter file, and acts on frame-accurate reviewer comments.
features.limits_or_cost: Manual editing is free; agent work uses credits. No cap on footage for first draft.

features.detail: Assistant either generates the missing shot or searches licensed stock (iStock, Shutterstock, Storyblocks, others) and places it on the timeline.
features.limits_or_cost: Premium stock footage per seat per month: Starter 100, Plus 200, Max 500. Generated shots cost model credits.

features.detail: Click 'AI Twins' in the prompt box, choose 'YouTube to avatar' or 'Upload to avatar' (or webcam record). Express avatar: share a YouTube link or upload a short video of yourself (page says 60 s; another page says 30 s), built in under 5 minutes. Pro avatar: 30+ minutes of footage. Consent: read an on-screen consent code in English on camera; uploads without it are rejected with a prompt to re-record. Confirm with 'Looks good' with all boxes ticked. Avatar speaks in 50+ languages. Each new setup or outfit needs new footage.
features.limits_or_cost: Help article: Pro avatar costs 200 credits. Older article: AI twin videos about 0.67 credits per second (unverified for current plans).
features.notable: Spoken consent code inside the training clip is a lightweight, auditable consent gate for a face clone.

features.detail: Select 'Clone your voice', upload a recording of at least 30 seconds, then generate videos with the cloned voiceover, usable in multiple languages. Only with the speaker's permission; verification process stated.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan quota and credit cost not published on current pages (unverified).

features.feature: Prompt-to-video with Magic Box edit by command
features.detail: Choose a workflow, write a prompt with length, platform and voiceover accent, pick audience, platform and look, click 'Generate now'. Output: AI script, stock plus AI visuals, voiceover in 50+ languages, subtitles, music, transitions. Edit by typing commands in the Magic Box below the video (revealed by 'Edit & Download'): e.g. delete a scene, change accent, change music mood, add or remove subtitles, change subtitle style, animate subtitles word by word, make scene 2 funnier, reduce iStock usage. Regenerate via Versions re-asks Audience, Look and Feel, Platform.
features.limits_or_cost: Older help: regenerating counts minutes again. Current per-generation credits unverified.
features.notable: Natural-language edit box scoped to scene, line or whole video is the right UX for tweaking a remix without a timeline.

features.feature: Guided Workflows incl. Reframing, Localisation, Campaign Transfer
features.detail: Nine guided runs in Agent Two: Casting, Reference Research, Production Design, Storyboarding, Ad KV Variations, Localisation, PDP Assets, Campaign Transfer (rebuild a reference campaign's language around your product), Reframing (extend 16:9 shots to 9:16, extensions approved as images before video). User answers the workflow's questions, uploads references, chooses from options. Users can define their own step sequence, saved as a markdown file and attachable to future projects. Casting saves character voices to Context for reuse.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits per generation; not published per workflow.
features.notable: Saved, reusable workflow recipes (as markdown) map well to 'remix recipes' per content format.

features.detail: Playbooks hold standing rules for process, language and per-generation options applied on every project. Project Context stores uploads and characters so the agent interprets new inputs against them ('infinite memory'). Slate imports brand assets (recurring product window, jingle, brand font) and places them across the project.
features.notable: Standing rules applied to every generation is how compliance wording and brand voice could be enforced automatically.

features.detail: Assistant translates a cut into other languages with lip sync. Avatar page: avatars speak in 50+ languages; prompt-to-video voiceovers in 50+ languages.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits; amount not published.

features.feature: Export: MP4, audio, still, editable NLE project
features.detail: Export MP4, audio-only or a still frame, or an editable project that opens in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve with cuts and layers intact. Exports are free and watermark-free. Direct posting to social platforms not found (unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: Exports use no credits.

features.feature: Multiplayer editing, review links and version control
features.detail: Real-time multiplayer with live cursors and comments; shareable review link with frame-accurate comments the agent can act on; branch the edit, tag versions, roll back; read-only session replay of how an edit was made; folder-level invites for external partners without a seat (Team and Enterprise).
features.limits_or_cost: Seats: Starter 5, Plus 10 plus 10 guests, Max 20 plus 20 guests.
features.notable: Review link where a manager's comment becomes an agent instruction fits a compliance-review step before posting.

features.feature: Generative model menu with per-model pricing
features.detail: Video models: Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling, Wan, Pixverse, Hailuo, Seedance 2.5 / 2.0 / 2.0 Fast / 2.0 Mini. Image models: Nano Banana Pro, Ideogram, Seedream, Flux Kontext, Qwen, Imagen, Reve. Audio: ElevenLabs, Minimax. Video billed per second (credits per second x duration; resolution, video input and audio raise the rate).
features.limits_or_cost: Nano Banana Pro about 2.5 credits per image (4K about 4). Seedance 2.5 1080p about 96 credits per 5 s, 720p about 56, Draft about 24.5. Starter: no Seedance 2.5.

features.detail: Credits per seat per month (400 / 2,000 / 5,000). Paid-plan credits reset monthly, no rollover. Add-on credits valid up to 12 months or until subscription ends. Manual timeline editing, export and download are free. Upgrades mid-cycle are prorated. Vendor reserves the right to change credit costs without notice.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter $10, Plus $30, Max $75 per seat per month annual; $20 / $60 / $150 monthly.
features.notable: Free manual editing plus paid AI keeps users in the tool even when out of credits.

features.detail: Upload a video or audio file of at least 10 minutes, or paste a link (MP4, MOV, AVI, FLV and more). Optional prompt naming topics in words or short phrases (e.g. 'Find clips related to growing up, being a teen...'), and you can ask for a ratio like 4:5 or 16:9. With no prompt it makes 3-5 clips in 9:16 'mobile output format with subtitles and a title'. Refine in the prompt box (longer, shorter, other topics). Clips are resized, keep the active speaker on screen (Speaker Focus), get word-by-word animated subtitles, and filler words and unrelated footage are removed. Open in Studio to restyle subtitles, add images or music, or fix via Trim with Transcript. Works on videos without audio by analysing visuals.
features.limits_or_cost: 2 credits per minute. Free plan watermarked.
features.notable: Default output is already postable (9:16, subtitles, title) and the chat box handles revisions.

features.detail: Auto-resize a project to platform presets (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Shorts, Instagram post, Facebook, LinkedIn) while detecting and centering the active speaker; blurred background fill option. Canvas resize keeps text layout intact.
features.limits_or_cost: Video Resize 4 credits per video.

features.detail: Smart Cut automatically removes silences ('Delete Silences'). The Automatic Video Editor removes silences, filler words, stutters or specific phrases based on a prompt ('Remove Filler Words'). Threshold and padding settings not documented (unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: Smart Cut uses no credits; Eye Contact page says Pro unlocks Smart Cut.

features.detail: Edit a clip like a text document: delete words or restore missing sentences in the transcript and the video cuts follow.
features.limits_or_cost: Transcription-based editing: 1 credit per transcribed minute plus 1 credit per 5 minutes of input video.

features.detail: Subtitles tab -> 'Auto Subtitles' -> deselect assets not to transcribe -> choose audio language and output language (or 'Translate transcript into another language') -> edit text -> 'Characters Per Subtitle' slider. Animation tab: word-by-word highlighting on or off, animation style and colors. Presets include 'Pop Art', 'Typewriter', 'Handwriting' (marketing claims 100+ preset styles; emoji subtitles and bouncing text on subtitle editor page). Background padding, box width, drag to position, 'Safe Zones' overlay for social UIs. Save a style to Brand Kit via the '...' menu. Export SRT/VTT, TXT transcript, or burn in. One subtitle language per track.
features.limits_or_cost: Transcription 1 credit/min; translation 2 credits/min. Free up to 10 min; Pro up to 1,000 min/mo; Business up to 4,000 min/mo.
features.notable: Safe Zones overlay and saving a caption style to the brand kit as the default.

features.feature: Clean Audio, Enhance Voice, Split Vocals, auto leveling
features.detail: Clean Audio removes background noise; Enhance Voice improves speech; Split Vocals separates voice from music; auto volume leveling evens loudness across one or more tracks.
features.limits_or_cost: Clean Audio 2 credits/min (Free 5 min, Pro 500 min/mo, Business 2,000 min/mo); Enhance Voice 4 credits/min; Split Vocals 10 credits/min.

features.detail: Select the video on canvas -> right sidebar 'AI Tools' -> 'Eye Contact'. Redirects gaze to camera, leaves expressions unchanged. Seconds for clips under 1 minute. Export MP4, MOV or WebM up to 4K.
features.limits_or_cost: 30 credits per minute. Pro plan required.
features.notable: Lets an adviser read a remixed script off-screen and still look at the lens.

features.detail: Images tab in left sidebar -> 'Smart B-roll'. Reads the transcript for key themes and visual moments and inserts matching B-roll automatically. Needs spoken audio.
features.limits_or_cost: Credit cost unverified.

features.detail: 'Smart Tools' > 'Dub Audio': choose target language, voice and speaker settings; or upload a translated SRT/VTT to drive the dub. Auto-detects source language (155 variants) and speakers, assigns a voice per speaker, keeps original background audio (keep, delete or replace). 149 target options (110 languages plus 39 dialects). Editing the transcript re-translates; 'Apply changes to dubbed audio' or 'Regenerate dubbed audio' per section. Lip Sync optional afterwards in Smart Tools. Trimmed source dubs only the trimmed part.
features.limits_or_cost: Dubbing about 10 credits per 30 s (Pro up to 50 min/mo, Business 200). Lip Sync 30 credits/min, Pro or Business. Free: videos under 8 min. Voice cloned from original speaker only on Business and Enterprise.

features.feature: Kai chat creation with storyboard and credit estimate
features.detail: Open via 'AI Assistant' sidebar, homepage prompt 'What are you creating today', or editor 'AI' tab. 'Attach media' (videos, reference images, audio, PDF; was 10 per prompt, raised above 10 in May 2026). Kai returns a storyboard to change script, b-roll, aspect ratio (1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 4:5, 5:4) and voice-over before generating. Slider icon sets model preferences (auto-routed by default; e.g. GPT Image 2, Seedance 2.0, ElevenLabs). Shows credit estimate; user can ask for a cheaper plan. Outputs: short scenes, fully edited videos with stock b-roll, AI avatar UGC/spokesperson videos. Chats saved per user. Example prompts: 'Create a 30-second vertical product video with subtitles and music', 'Merge these five uploaded clips into one video', 'Add Spanish subtitles to this video'.
features.limits_or_cost: Kai images 4-6 credits; audio 10 credits per song or SFX; video varies by length, resolution, model (FAQ: 60 s video 13-60 credits). Credits consumed even if output disliked; failed jobs refunded.
features.notable: Storyboard checkpoint with a visible credit estimate before generation.

features.detail: By chat: adjust brightness, blur, contrast; preset filters (black and white, sepia); outlines, rounded corners, borders, drop shadows; move layer to preset positions (top right, center, full screen); layer order; fade audio in or out; detach audio; remove or blur background; delete layers; timed text overlays at top, middle or bottom at a given moment; blur or redact objects via prompt. Fine timing, layers and text styling still go to Studio.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits per action vary.

features.detail: 'Explore' -> 'Create custom Kai': name, description (use case reminder, not the prompt), custom chat placeholder text, plus an uploaded sample input and the example output. Reusable for a style, effect, workflow, character or brand; shareable publicly. Gallery of featured preconfigured Kais for trending formats (e.g. celebrity selfie, baby predictor, gender swap). Brands use them to set up internal formats.
features.limits_or_cost: Runs on normal credits.
features.notable: A gallery of trending-format recipes that run on your own inputs is a template-level remix; pairing input and example output teaches the recipe.

features.detail: Brand Kit stores logos, colors, fonts (custom TTF/OTF on paid), subtitle styles, overlays and reusable brand templates (including audio-only podcast templates), and up to 2 voice clones on Business. 'Brand Characters' saved in Brand Kit are referenced in Kai prompts with @name (spaces become underscores) for consistent characters.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and above. Voice clones Business only.
features.notable: @mentioning a saved brand character or voice inside a prompt is a neat way to inject 'my face, my voice' into a remix.

features.feature: Text to speech and voice clone
features.detail: TTS voices (ElevenLabs). Voice clone via 'Add new Voice' in the Text to Speech dropdown; requires rights to the voice; voice page says 1-5 min audio sample. AI Characters gallery (casual, professional, fictional) for consistent character videos.
features.limits_or_cost: TTS 1 credit per 100 characters (Free 1 min, Pro 50 min/mo, Business 200 min/mo). Voice clone Business only.

features.detail: Shared workspaces, project sharing, comments, real-time collaboration, folders, workspace Media Library, Brand Kits. Every member needs a paid seat; adding a member mid-cycle is prorated; usage limits are per workspace. Storage warnings when near the limit.
features.limits_or_cost: Storage 5 GB Free (3-day retention) / 200 GB Pro / 800 GB Business.

features.detail: Upload video (MP4, MOV, WebM, OGG, AVI, 3GP, MPEG, WMV, FLV, MKV), images, audio, SRT; or import by URL from many public sites (can break). 'Export Project' to MP4, PNG, JPG, MP3, GIF. No direct social publishing or scheduling found (unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: Free: 250 MB per file, 720p, watermark. Paid: 6 GB per file, 4K, 120 min exports, no watermark; re-export old projects without watermark while paid.

features.detail: One credit pool across AI tools. Free tools with no credits: background removal, image enhance, blur background, stabilize, chroma key, Find Scenes, Smart Cut, audio waveform. Every credit tool costs at least 1 credit. Failed operations auto-refunded; successful but unwanted generations are not.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 10 lifetime, Pro 1,000/mo, Business 4,000/mo; Business top-up 500 credits for $50.

features.detail: Search a topic across TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels from a 3M+ viral video database, or use a personal feed matched to your AI topics, refreshed daily. Sort by engagement rate (weighted over raw views), likes, comments or recency; filter by duration, platform and date. Watch each post in place with its transcript and stats. Follow competitor channels so their new hits appear in your feed. Save to a personal feed.
features.limits_or_cost: Free, including on free accounts.
features.notable: Engagement-rate ranking (not views) surfaces small accounts with outsized engagement; inline transcript plus stats gives the remix input.

features.detail: Open a viral post and choose a mode. 'Repurpose': keeps the core idea, hook and pacing, generates a new script, visuals and voice-over, adds captions. 'Part 2': continues the source's story thread with a new payoff. 'Restyle': applies an AI edit to real footage you have rights to (changes the look, no new visuals). Edit anything in the browser editor before export; export vertical, square or horizontal from one project.
features.limits_or_cost: Generation uses credits (a 30 s video with Pro moving images and voice about 40-80 credits). Per-mode cost unverified.
features.notable: The three modes are the clearest public spec of 'remix': same idea new version, sequel, and restyle own footage. FAQ draws the rights line: new original allowed, re-uploading others' footage not.

features.detail: Every remix records its source video so you can trace what inspired it. A winning remix can be turned into a series with one click.
features.notable: Storing the source link on each remix enables later analysis of which source styles win for this user, and attribution if challenged.

features.detail: Public category galleries of real Revid videos ranked by quality ('Best' / 'Newest'). Each card shows title, views, style, tier, and 'See inside' opens a breakdown (prompt, style, quality, format such as 9:16 vertical, length such as 40s). 'Remix this video' opens the editor with the same tool, style and format prefilled: 'Change anything before you generate.'
features.limits_or_cost: Credits on generate.
features.notable: 'See inside' recipe card plus prefilled remix is a good pattern for remixing proven posts made inside the product.

features.feature: Create flow: script, prompt, link or recording
features.detail: 'Create New Video' -> pick a tool (Short Video Generator, Prompt to Video, Article to Video; 'Show More Tools' for 100+). Input: 'Your Video Script' box, a prompt, a pasted URL (YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Spotify, Suno, SoundCloud, articles), or 'Record' tab to upload or record with a teleprompter (transcript becomes script). For URLs, 'How should we handle your content': Summarize (default), Summarize if long (over 500 characters), Keep as is. Visuals: stock, moving AI images, AI video, own media or gameplay; quality tier, style preset, mood, characters; ratio 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 or Auto; media density Few/Medium/More; story style (General, How To, Listicle, Educational). Voice, music, caption preset. Toggles: stickers, sound effects, cover/thumbnail, watermark, NSFW filter, language optimization. 'Estimated cost' shown beside 'Generate video'. Hooks, script generation and rewrites included on all paid plans.
features.limits_or_cost: Estimate shown before generating; failed renders refunded.
features.notable: Recording with built-in teleprompter feeding the script is the 'my face' path without an avatar.

features.detail: 16 editor presets: DEFAULT, REVID, HORMOZI, ALI, WRAP1, WRAP2, FACELESS, ELEGANT, DIFFERENCE, OPACITY, PLAYFUL, BOLD PUNCH, MOVIE, OUTLINE, COVE, BEAT (API lists 31 incl. Karaoke, Contextual). Position top, middle or bottom; font size and highlight color editable; Custom tab for fonts and colors. On by default, word-by-word synced. 'Disable Captions' toggle. Transcription in 100+ languages; captions follow the voice-over language. 'Behind Subject' captions render behind the speaker.
features.limits_or_cost: High-quality transcription 10 credits/min. Behind Subject 20 credits per started 30 s. Contextual 1 credit per started second.

features.detail: Input one YouTube video URL (no channels or playlists). Options: 1-3 clips (default 1), clip length 10-120 s (default 60), search query describing moments to find, or exact range 'start:end'. Ratio 9:16 (default), 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 or auto. Auto-reframe with face tracking on by default. Captions default preset 'Wrap 1' at bottom. Optional B-roll (frequency 0-1, split-screen or fullscreen), generated music, 'AI video editor' mode that turns key lines into motion graphics with camera punch-ins. Output 720p, 1080p (default) or 4K; 1-60 fps. No virality score.
features.limits_or_cost: 10 credits per call plus generation; auto-reframe 10 credits; music 20 credits per started minute.

features.detail: Left panels: Frames, Slide, Text, Media, Audio, Captions, Settings. Top bar: title, ratio switcher, Safe zones toggle, Export. Edit segment text and retime in Frames; split with scissor. Shift-select frames -> 'Generate matching media'. 'Regenerate from prompt' changes one scene only. Audio: music library or upload, voice-over, sound effects (preset, AI from prompt, ambient). Full undo history. Export 720p, 1080p, 4K (beta), 30 or 60 fps, MP4 or GIF, compression Low/Medium/High; then download or 'Publish'.
features.limits_or_cost: 4K export 10 credits; AI upscaling 5 credits per second.
features.notable: Per-scene regenerate keeps the rest of a remix stable while fixing one shot.

features.feature: Talking avatars, face swap and video podcasts
features.detail: Script or URL to avatar video. Avatar types: Custom (upload your own image or video; zoomed-out landscape video recommended), Fantasy, Celebrity-style, Misc. 'Remove Avatar Background' overlays the avatar on B-roll as picture-in-picture. Face swap: upload a source video (single speaker, up to about 2 min) and one reference face; keeps original voice, timing, motion; optional 'Replace Voice'. Video podcast: '[Alice] line' per turn, assign voice and avatar per speaker in Character Picker; AI dialogue writer from topic. Character (LoRA) training for consistent characters.
features.limits_or_cost: Avatar per 500 characters: Low 80, Pro 100, Ultra 200 credits. Remove background 20. Face swap 50 (Pro) or 100 (Ultra) per started 5 s. LoRA training 200.
features.notable: Face swap on a source clip keeping timing and motion is the most literal 'my face' remix; needs strong consent controls.

features.detail: Voice library filterable by language, gender, age, use case, accent; 75 languages (30 full multilingual, 45 via v3 model). Speed 0.7x-1.2x in 0.05 steps (default 1x). Stability: Stable, Balanced (default), Expressive. 'Create / Clone Voice': Voice Generation (from text description) or Voice Clone (from audio samples).
features.limits_or_cost: Voice 10 credits per 500 characters. Cloning requires Elite ($89/mo). Sample length unverified.

features.detail: Connect TikTok, YouTube (Shorts and standard) and Instagram (Reels) in Account Settings; 'Publish' after export, or schedule. Each channel has a queue; posts without a time take the channel's next open slot; scheduled time accepts ISO 8601 or Unix seconds in account timezone. Webhooks deliver finished videos to any URL.
features.limits_or_cost: Publishing uses no credits. Paid plans only.
features.notable: Per-channel queue slots (drop a video in, it takes the next slot) is simpler than picking a time for every post.

features.detail: After posting to connected accounts, per-post views and engagement report back to the Revid dashboard.
features.limits_or_cost: Depth of analytics unverified (publishing doc does not mention analytics).

features.detail: Configure a worker once: a tool or workflow, a content source (prompt, feed or niche) and creation settings. It generates one video per day and auto-publishes to connected TikTok, YouTube or Instagram, or sends to a webhook.
features.limits_or_cost: 3 workers Growth, 5 Elite, 10 Ultra. Generation credits per video.

features.detail: Paste a product link; Revid reads offer, buyers, benefits, pain points, competitors and brand tone, shows a brand profile, then drafts a 7-day calendar. Each day card has tool, 'Objective', 'Angle', format, 'big idea' and 'Goes to' (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn). Review and edit the profile and every card, then activate as a daily worker that makes one video overnight and adds a new day after each run. 'Nothing posts without you': each video arrives with 'Review' and 'Post'.
features.limits_or_cost: Image and video generations use credits.
features.notable: Offer page in, editable weekly plan out, human approval before posting. Maps directly to an adviser's offer page feeding a content week.

features.feature: API, MCP server and CLI with free cost estimate
features.detail: REST API v3, MCP server with 23 tools, revid-cli npm package. 'POST /api/public/v3/calculate-credits' estimates cost without an API key; 'revid create --dry-run --json' inspects a payload without spending. Webhook or status polling per render.
features.limits_or_cost: Included on all paid plans.

features.detail: AI video per 5 s: Low 15, Low image-to-video 40, Pro 50, Ultra 100, Seedance 1080p 250, Seedance 4K 500, Veo3 100 (pro rata). Motion graphics 2/3/5 credits per second (15 s min). Images 1/4/16; image edit 8. Voice 10 per 500 chars. Music 20 per generation; 199-track library free; SFX 1. Estimates: 30 s video about 40-50 credits with Pro moving images, about 100 with Low AI video, 600+ with Veo3.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth 2,000 / Elite 5,000 / Ultra 12,000 credits per month.

features.detail: Sidebar agent inside the Editor. Example prompts: 'make a reel from the part about tacos', 'find the funniest moment', 'Make me a teaser featuring [topic]', 'Find all mentions of [topic]', 'Enhance my episode's audio, cut filler, fix eye gaze, and clean up pauses', 'write a LinkedIn post about this episode', 'Write a short newsletter summarizing this episode.' Outputs: platform-adapted clips, teasers, highlight reels, Reels with hook and variants, captions, hooks, takeaways, CTAs, hashtags, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, thumbnails, blog posts. 'Personalize': describe your show and add a custom style or tone, applied to all generated assets.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and above. Uses AI credits (Pro 2,000 to start, Business 12,000); per-action cost unverified.
features.notable: One agent both edits the video and writes the post copy in the user's saved tone.

features.detail: From a Riverside recording or an uploaded video, AI picks highlights; focus by speaker, topics or keywords; adjust duration, speaker focus, background, layout. Ratio presets for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram (16:9, 1:1, 9:16). Highlight a transcript passage to make a clip manually. Save default ratio, layout, branding and length as presets. Branded captions in one click. Optional animated characters. No virality score.
features.limits_or_cost: Available on Free ('100% free' claim); Free exports 720p with watermark.
features.notable: Saved clip presets (ratio, layout, branding, length) so every clip comes out on-brand without setup.

features.detail: Automatically adjusts gaze to the camera, even when reading a script or glancing off-screen.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and above.

features.feature: Remove Silences, Remove Fillers, Find Fluff
features.detail: 'Remove Silences' cuts all or chosen silences (natural to very snappy). 'Remove Fillers' removes um, uh, stumbles, slip-ups. 'Find Fluff' flags intros, rambles and behind-the-scenes chatter for one-click delete. In chat editing the user sets silence and filler sensitivity and how fast layouts switch. 'Smooth Cuts' (coming soon) hides jump cuts.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and above.

features.detail: Fix a typo or rewrite a line in the transcript; AI regenerates that audio in the same voice with lip sync.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan and credits unverified.
features.notable: For regulated advisers, swapping one non-compliant phrase without a reshoot is very valuable.

features.detail: Generates footage to fill visual gaps from your script, scene or a prompt; no stock licence needed.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and above; credits unverified.

features.detail: One click 'Magic Audio' in the AI Producer bar bundles 5 tools: background noise removal, reverb and echo reduction, sound equalizer, voice enhancer, loudness and volume leveling. Inputs: Riverside recordings or uploads (MP3, WAV, OGG, MP4, MPEG, WEBM). No intensity settings documented.
features.limits_or_cost: Free plan available; limits unverified.

features.detail: Give your avatar a script and it generates an on-camera performance in your look and cloned 48 kHz voice. 'Smart references' auto-picks a clear reference from your existing recordings. Output becomes a recording in the Riverside editor for B-roll, captions, branding, clips and publishing. Stated uses: A/B test hooks and CTAs, localization, personalized versions per recipient, pickups and inserts without reshoot.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan, credits, required footage and consent flow unverified.
features.notable: Twin built from footage the user already recorded removes the separate training shoot; A/B hook variants is a strong remix use.

features.detail: Pick a recording or edit, set target language (30+) and lip sync on or off, start. Speaker-specific voice cloning for up to 4 speakers. Input under 60 minutes. About 20 minutes processing per minute of video, email when done. Output: translated version plus editable translated transcript; can trim, split, make Magic Clips, add captions. Captions only in the spoken language.
features.limits_or_cost: Business plan only; uses AI credits.

features.detail: AI captions in 100+ languages; choose a preset style, font, color, size, alignment, position and animation. Download SRT from the project dashboard or 'Tracks' section.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan not stated; preset names not published.

features.detail: One calendar for social posts plus recordings, live streams, webinars and podcast releases. Schedule to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, X and Facebook. 'Descriptions that write themselves': post description auto-generated from the content, editable. One-click aspect ratio switch for platform versions.
features.limits_or_cost: Grow plan ($39/mo, $34/mo annual) per pricing page. Analytics not mentioned.
features.notable: Production (recordings) and distribution (posts) on the same calendar.

features.detail: Record up to 4K with separate audio and video tracks, host teleprompter (host and guests on Business), in-person multi-cam, async recording, presentation recorder; Mac and mobile apps. Publishing to YouTube, Spotify, Apple, Instagram, LinkedIn from Pro.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 2 hours multi-track; Pro 5 hours/mo; Grow 15 hours/mo separate track downloads per comparison table.

features.detail: Studio Branding (logos, colors, overlays); Magic Clips custom backgrounds, brand color palette, text, music or image overlays; captions styled from brand kit in Co-Creator. Business adds custom branding.
Free, Pro, Grow, Webinar, Business. Editor seats are add-ons on Pro, Grow, Webinar. AI credits are granted to start (Pro 2,000, Business 12,000); AI Translation consumes credits.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro $29/mo or $24/mo annual; Grow $39 or $34; Webinar $99 or $79; Business custom.

features.feature: Prompt, script, link or voice to finished video
features.detail: Start from a text prompt, script, blog URL ('Blog to Video'), one photo ('Image to Video'), product info, or a voice recording. Choose pacing, voice, music and visual tone; customizable templates. Output: edited video with visuals, AI voiceover, music and captions, then manual tweaks. Also faceless video generator and AI Scene Generator.
features.limits_or_cost: Video length cap 30 s Free, 2 min Cat Mode, 5 min Super Cat and up. Videos per month 15 / 40 / unlimited.

features.detail: Analyzes your website, content and niche to propose a short-form video plan; you approve themes and cadence; approved videos are scheduled and posted to your social channels; it tracks what performs and uses that to improve future videos.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan needed and platforms list unverified (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram named as targets).
features.notable: Closed loop: plan from the brand's site, post, learn from results.

features.feature: AI avatars and custom digital twin
features.detail: Hundreds of avatars; customize ethnicity, age, style, voice, language, expressions. Custom avatars from a prompt, a 'digital twin' of yourself, or a product presenter; owned forever once created. Input requirements for twin unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: Free and Cat Mode: limited public library. Super Cat: 120+ premium, 5 custom per month. Unlimited Cat: 10 per month. Enterprise: unlimited.

features.detail: 'Upload Your Voice' (about a minute of speech or a short file) -> 'Create Your AI Clone' -> 'Use It Anywhere' for TTS in any video. 170+ languages. Explicit speaker permission required; verification stated. Better mic gives a better clone.
features.limits_or_cost: Super Cat 5 clones per month, Unlimited Cat 10, Enterprise unlimited. Credit cost unverified.

features.detail: Captions generated automatically; drag to any position, change font, size, wording, timing and style; supports right-to-left languages; include or exclude subtitles on export. Named presets unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: Export 720p Free, 1080p paid.

features.detail: Upload a video and translate it into other languages; voice and lip sync adapt automatically.
features.limits_or_cost: 25+ languages; Super Cat and above.

features.feature: Automated editing with capped free edits
features.detail: Zebracat handles cutting, syncing, transitions and effects automatically; 'You review and publish.' Each video includes a number of free edit rounds.
features.limits_or_cost: Free edits per video: 3 Cat Mode, 3 Super Cat, 5 Unlimited Cat, unlimited Enterprise.
features.notable: Capping edit rounds per video is a visible cost-control lever worth considering.

features.detail: Saved brand kits per plan applied to videos. Contents of a kit unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 Cat Mode, 5 Super Cat, unlimited Unlimited Cat and Enterprise.

features.detail: Veo, Kling, Seedance and more selectable in one tool for generated scenes.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses generative AI credits (350 / 1,400 / 3,600 per month by plan; figures inconsistent on page).

features.detail: Public API and MCP server pages linked from the homepage; Enterprise lists API access.
features.limits_or_cost: Enterprise $599+/mo for API per pricing; MCP plan gate unverified.

features.detail: Free plan watermarked at 720p; paid plans remove watermark and export 1080p (FAQ claims 4K, conflicting). 7-day money-back guarantee on the pricing page, but FAQ says no refunds for partial months.
features.limits_or_cost: Cat Mode $39/mo or $23 yearly; Super Cat $99 or $59; Unlimited Cat $199 or $119; Enterprise $599+.
